missions.name: [DESTINATION] Errand
missions.overview:
Got a box sitting at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> that needs to make its way over to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. Any chance you can knock this out real quick?

Might be the easiest gig I’ve ever assigned out. Only real threat would be tripping over your own feet. A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

missions.description_lore:
Citizens for Prosperity have entrenched themselves at [Pickup1|Address]. To keep them from getting too comfy at that station, we want to show them what life is really like in our system. We’ll pay you to hit the station, grab the [item], and kill anyone that gets in your way. 

Payment hinges on you delivering those supplies to [Dropoff1|Address]. Anyone you kill will just be a perk.     

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.name: [DESTINATION] Stroll
missions.overview:
Any chance you’re at [DESTINATION]?

Need a box hustled from <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. Get it there on time and unbroken and it’ll be the easiest creds you’ll ever earn.   

-Smokey

I need you to travel to <EM4>Glaciem Ring Wreck Site</EM4> and see if our contractor, <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4>, is truly gone.

Vaughn

missions.overview:

missions.description_lore:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

missions.name: [LOCATION] needs assistance
missions.overview:
Headhunters have launched an unprovoked attack against [LOCATION]. Although we don't support the use of violence, Citizens for Prosperity won't let innocent people die. We need qualified security personnel to retake the outpost.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.description_lore:
We need any available security personnel to report to [Location|Address]. A group of armed individuals have attacked one of our outpost clusters and we're in desperate need of help. Although the group seems to be unaffiliated with any of the known gangs, we've received word that their leader is [TargetName], a local outlaw with a vicious reputation.

Please head out as soon as you can and secure the area by taking out the outlaws and [TargetName|Last].

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: [LOCATION] needs help
missions.overview:
We just received reports of a massive attack against [LOCATION] by a large group of armed individuals led by [TARGET], a notorious outlaw who has been threatening Citizens for Prosperity personnel for months. Details are still yet to be confirmed but we know there have been multiple casualties.

Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any qualified security personnel to go and retake the outposts from these hostile elements. Our understanding is that [TARGET] tends to hide behind their soldiers, but will emerge if you take enough of the rank-and-file out.

While we don't like to resort to violence, management can see no other way of resolving this situation and continuing our good work in the system.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.overview:
Hey if you’re reading this, we need a hand. An outpost of ours down at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> got hit by a nasty storm and suffered some damage. None of our usual techs are available (or alive) to swing by so we wanna hire someone to go fix some fuses (no idea how many but <EM4>no more than three</EM4> I think). If you can bring a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4> with <EM4>enough RMC canisters to sort out around three pipes</EM4>, we should be good.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the <EM4>“Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

missions.description_lore:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!



* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

missions.name: A Chance to Impress
missions.overview:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TARGET] over at [LOCATION].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.name: Adagio Holdings in Need of Salvagers
missions.overview:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.

This introductory contract will require you to head to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.

Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

tactical_analysis.content: Meta Hull-C: Acepta contratos unverified de 20k en Hurston. Si no es un Hull-C, abandona y busca de nuevo.
4.7 Cargo Bug: Mueve cajas de Stims individualmente con el tractor beam 'MaxLift' para evitar clipping explosivo.
Estrategia PRO: Enfócate 100% en extraer Stims y Medical Supplies. Vende todo en TDD de HUR-L1.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

missions.description_lore:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.description_lore:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

Safe Hauling,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

missions.overview:
Got a big job for a big player. We’re in the process of making someone disappear, like completely vanish, and a part of that is recovering the blackbox from the “accident” that they had recently over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>.
Only problem is, seems the people this person hired to stage the accident have gotten it in their heads that there’s more money to be made. So much so that they’re still keeping tabs on the now deceased’s ship.
These guys aren’t playing around either. You’ll need a couple of friends to help you do this. But if you can get the blackbox out of there and into our hands by dropping it at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>, we can really make it worth your while.

-Bit Zeros

missions.description_lore:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [RewardValue_Wanted1] UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!



* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

missions.overview:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #BR74382
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
A known outlaw attacked and destroyed a ship near <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. The agency has been contracted to retrieve the ship’s blackbox in order to build a case against them and lobby for Advocacy intervention. 

Contract Investigator Actions:
An operative is needed to head to the crime scene at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>, secure the area from any hostiles present to procure the blackbox, and deliver to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Be advised that there are still <EM4>hostile forces in the area</EM4> that will attack. These will most likely have some experience fighting, so be prepared. 

This contract has been flagged as a <EM4>combat mission</EM4>.

missions.name: Blackbox Recovery Request: Special Investigator Level
missions.overview:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #BR547384
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
This request comes down from Head Office. 

We’ve just learned that a recent ship attack near <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> might have been the work of a notorious and equally elusive outlaw ringleader. The last time they popped their head above water was years ago, so this is a rare opportunity to catch them. This is an opportunity that our client does not want to pass up. We need a <EM4>top-tier operative</EM4> with elite combat experience to retrieve the blackbox of this downed ship in order to prove the ringleader’s involvement.

<EM4>There will be highly-trained hostiles present on the scene</EM4> who will put up significant resistance to your presence. Eliminate them and complete the mission.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Immediately scramble to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and clear the surrounding airspace in order to secure the blackbox. Once obtained, deliver it to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Head Office stresses that this will be an incredibly difficult mission to pull off. Make sure you bring your A-game.

-Bit Zeros

missions.description_lore:
We need any available security personnel to report to [Location|Address]. A group of armed individuals have attacked one of our outpost clusters and we're in desperate need of help. Although the group seems to be unaffiliated with any of the known gangs, we've received word that their leader is [TargetName], a local outlaw with a vicious reputation.

Please head out as soon as you can and secure the area by taking out the outlaws and [TargetName|Last].

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: Block XenoThreat Expansion
missions.overview:
XenoThreat are on the warpath right now. They’ve launched simultaneous attacks on several Headhunters sites and stretched our fighters thin. Got word they’re planning to storm [LOCATION] next, and we can’t get anyone there to defend it. 

I’m looking to pay someone to pull together a crew, gather supplies, and mount a strong defense for us. Gonna be honest with you, this is shaping up to be a hell of a fight. Xenos are sending some of their most experienced forces there. Not much else I can say except that they’ll probably stagger the arrival of their forces, wipe them all out and you’ll be paid handsomely. 

Think you can rise to the occasion?  

-Stows

Best of luck,

Braden Corchado

missions.description_lore:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [RewardValue_Wanted1] UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!



* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

missions.description_lore:
Normally, I like to cook everything from scratch myself. Pride in product and all. But every once in a while, whether it's too much demand or too much heat or whatever, I need to rely on other labs for an order. 

My hands are tied up here though, so I could use someone to help oversee the whole production line for me. Couldn't think of anyone better and more available than you.

* TO-DO LIST *

1. PROCESSING - Take the raw material from  [Pickup1|Address] to [Pickup2|Address]
2. PACKAGING - Take the refined product from  [Pickup2|Address] to [Pickup3|Address]
3. DISTRIBUTION - Take the finished goods from  [Pickup3|Address] to [DropOff1|Address]

Just don't get distracted in the middle and wander off. It happens more often than you'd think. Manage to finish the full list, and I'll see to it you get nice cut of the profits.

-Wallace

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator

missions.name: Cargo Hauling Opportunity with Ling Hauling
missions.overview:
Hi,  
 
This is Petra Ling, and I’m proud to offer you a new and exciting opportunity to partner with Ling Family Hauling. When my parents started this company, their goal was to provide fast and reliable courier deliveries around the greater Crusader area. It quickly became a success, and as our reputation grew, so did our operations.  
 
Now, under my stewardship, Ling Family Hauling is taking the next big step – cargo hauling. Demand for this new service is growing faster than I expected, and that’s great news for both of us.   
 
If you’ve ever wanted to be a hauler, then I can make your dreams come true. Best way to learn something is by doing it, and I’ve got a haul of <EM4>[ITEM]</EM4> that needs to go from <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.  

No prior experience is necessary, but here’s a few things to keep in mind. All pick-ups and deliveries must be done at a freight elevator or autoloaded. You will need a ship that can hold <EM4>2 SCU cargo containers</EM4>, and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to move them around. 
 
Upon successful completion of this delivery, you will be promoted to a ‘trusted contractor’ status and more hauls will become available to you.     

 
Sincerely,  
Petra Ling  
Managing Director of Cargo Operations 
Ling Family Hauling 

 

 

 

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

missions.name: Cargo Retrieval
missions.overview:
Need someone to snag some cargo for us. We were using an old Hathor PAF for dead drops, but a local gang has dug in and we can’t get our shit.

If you feel like kicking some ass, grab the cargo from the freight elevator at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. 

From what I’ve heard this place is full of all sorts. Won’t be easy getting out stuff back, but that’s what we’re paying you for.

Just make sure you got a ship that can handle a <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> load, and try not to get shot in the process. A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

missions.name: Pyro VeryHard RecoverCargo
missions.overview:
More and more CFP ships are being targeted lately, and despite our best efforts to keep our trading routes quiet, we're still losing haulers to outlaw attacks.

Our pilot over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> is the latest casualty. It pains me to think about how much we've lost, but as long as there are people who need our help, we have to keep on fighting.

If you have a ship that can carry <EM4>[MAX_SCU] cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>, we need you to head to the above location and recover that cargo.

This won't be easy, the pilot was one of our best and wouldn't go down without a fight. Let's not underestimate these outlaws, bring a trustworthy crew and watch each other's backs.

Once you've got the cargo, deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> and I'll get it processed.

Good luck and take care,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: Cargo Transfer from Shuttered Facility
missions.overview:
RED WIND LINEHAUL 
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS' 
----------------------------    

ASD reached out to us as it seems one of their old labs, <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>, still has some cargo being stored there they want to get their hands on.

You would fly there in a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> in size, land in the hangar, load up from the freight elevator, and then transport it all back to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. 

Just be sure to keep your head on swivel while you’re at the facility and try not to let your curiosity get the better of you Abandoned sites like this can be home to all sort of nastiness.  And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along. 

BE YOUR BEST – Take pride in the work you do and you’ll do work to be proud of.

My hands are tied up here though, so I could use someone to help oversee the whole production line for me. Couldn't think of anyone better and more available than you.

1. PROCESSING - Take the raw material from  [Pickup1|Address] to [Pickup2|Address]
2. PACKAGING - Take the refined product from  [Pickup2|Address] to [Pickup3|Address]
3. DISTRIBUTION - Take the finished goods from  [Pickup3|Address] to [DropOff1|Address]

Just don't get distracted in the middle and wander off. It happens more often than you'd think. Manage to finish the full list, and I'll see to it you get nice cut of the profits.

-Wallace

missions.name: Cleaning Up Someone Else’s Mess
missions.overview:
You know when you ask someone a question and you have a feeling they’re lying, but you choose to give them the benefit of the doubt? Yeah. That’s what I’m dealing with right now.

Two “expert” haulers I hired to transport some gear for me ran into some trouble and ended up ditching my goods over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Needless to say, I’ve ordered a hit on them, but what I need from you is to go recover that cargo. The tracker says the cargo’s still on the ship, so you’ll just need a <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and your own ship to recover it.

You might run into a couple of scavengers lurking around there, but I doubt you’ll have any trouble with them.

When you’re done, take the stuff to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> and I’ll sort you out with a reward.

-Twitch

tactical_analysis.content: Quantum Nav Mode: Mantén escudos al 100% mientras cargas el motor para saltos rápidos.
Atmospheric Efficiency: Sube a 10km en ángulo de 45° antes de saltar en planetas con atmósfera.

missions.description_lore:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

ABOUT THE JOB
While your past performance has not been to our standards, microTech Protection Services has decided to offer you a chance to redeem yourself. 

To reevaluate your skills, we would like you to apprehend [TargetName] from [Location|Address].

While there will be other criminals at the site, your main focus should be on completing the bounty.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [Location|Address].
• Neutralize [TargetName]; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Bounty Hunters Guild membership and appropriate certification.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

missions.name: ShipWaveAttack ClearOutHostiles Nyx E
missions.overview:
To help protect our pilots, Citizens for Prosperity will often recommend the use of less traditional routes through the system. However, it seems that a gang of outlaws has gotten word and has begun to stage repeated ambushes along one such flightpath. You and whatever support ships you enlist will head to [LOCATION] and neutralize any hostiles you find laying in wait there. They have been known to operate in smaller packs, so it's vital that you wait until all of the hostiles have been dealt with.

Your assistance is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott

missions.description_lore:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.name: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #1
missions.overview:
Looking to gain critical hands-on experience battling a variety of targets and situations? Then my Combat Gauntlet might be the perfect fit for you.

Please understand that this course is intended for pilots who have already mastered flying basics and are ready to take their abilities to the next level. If you’re starting off and want to learn the ropes, I’d recommend logging some hours in an Arena Commander simpod. But for those ready to face a real challenge, I firmly believe that students learn best by doing. 

That’s why I’ve designed these eight scenarios to be as realistic as possible. I promise you this is the closest thing to Navy combat pilot training you can get without enlisting, so don’t expect a lot of hand holding. <EM4>The risk of injury to yourself or your ship should be taken very seriously.</EM4>

GAUNTLET SCENARIOS:
1. Single Targets
2. Multiple Targets
3. Target Priority
4. Target Stealth
5. Missiles and Countermeasures
6. Multi-Crew Targets
7. Corvette with Escorts
8. Capital Ship Encounter

So, if you’re ready to challenge yourself and prove you got what it takes to be a great pilot, the first scenario will focus on handling a single target. Head to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> to begin.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>1 MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Situational Awareness – Don’t get so focused on taking a target that you aren’t watching your flight path. No good taking out the enemy if you fly headfirst into an asteroid.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly    

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL 
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

missions.name: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #5
missions.overview:
Congrats on completing part four of this eight-part course.   

The fifth scenario focuses on defensive tactics. Knowing when to take evasive measures and deploy either decoys or noise countermeasures is essential to your survival. That’s why the aggressors in this exercise will be armed with missiles.   

Ensure your countermeasures are fully stocked and then go to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> to start.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>12 MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Ready to Launch - Easy access to your decoys and countermeasures can be critical in your success in dealing with incoming missile fire. 
- Stand and Fight - Resist the temptation to hit the afterburner to escape as you’ll increase your signature and make it easier for the missile to hit you. They’re almost certainly much faster than you anyway.
- Close the Gap – While it may seem counterintuitive, getting closer to an enemy ship can be an advantage. Missiles have a minimum range and if you’re inside of it they won’t be able to get a lock on you.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly

Not saying you can't overcome encounters like this by yourself, but even the Navy doesn’t send their ace pilots on a patrol alone.    

Once you decided whether to do this alone or call in some support, head over to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> to kick off the encounter.

missions.name: Ling Nyx Hard RecoverCargo
missions.overview:
Hello,

Some sad news. Unfortunately our hauler ran into some trouble and had to abandoned the cargo they were due to deliver. We haven't heard anything back from them so we're assuming the worse.

We're in the process of contacting their family and are conscious this is a very sensitive time, but also can't afford to leave a job incomplete. Our trackers show the cargo is still intact over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>.

If you could finish the delivery we would be really grateful. We're not picking up on any nearby ships so it should be safe for you to collect. Bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a ship that can carry <EM4>[MAX_SCU] cargo containers</EM4>.

Deliver the cargo to the freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> and we'll take care of the rest.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling 

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

missions.description_lore:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [RewardValue_Wanted1] UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!



* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

missions.description_lore:
Normally, I like to cook everything from scratch myself. Pride in product and all. But every once in a while, whether it's too much demand or too much heat or whatever, I need to rely on other labs for an order. 

My hands are tied up here though, so I could use someone to help oversee the whole production line for me. Couldn't think of anyone better and more available than you.

* TO-DO LIST *

1. PROCESSING - Take the raw material from  [Pickup1|Address] to [Pickup2|Address]
2. PACKAGING - Take the refined product from  [Pickup2|Address] to [Pickup3|Address]
3. DISTRIBUTION - Take the finished goods from  [Pickup3|Address] to [DropOff1|Address]

Just don't get distracted in the middle and wander off. It happens more often than you'd think. Manage to finish the full list, and I'll see to it you get nice cut of the profits.

-Wallace

missions.overview:

Head over, take out [TARGET] and then clear out any fuel stores they have there to convince anyone remaining to leave. 

Figure after you pull this off, nobody will even remember their name.

-Stows

missions.description_lore:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

missions.name: Refueling Nyx Hard
missions.overview:
Hi,

Another day another beacon. There's a <EM4>[SHIP]</EM4> with an empty tank at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>.  The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FUELRATE] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>[QTFUELRATE] aUEC per SCU of Quantum </EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.

If you decide to take the job, do me a favour and keep everything peeled. If you've got a buddy with time to spare, maybe reach out for a little back-up.

Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say. 
Actually she never said that - but I'm pretty sure she would if she did this for a living.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!



* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

missions.overview:
We were in the process of delivering an urgent shipment to the folks over at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> when our pilot ran into a group of outlaws. They tried to run, but it was already too late.

There is silver lining though. The trackers are showing the cargo is still intact, located at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. While I don't want to risk losing another pilot, the need of the cargo aboard is desperate enough that it justifies the decision to send someone to recover it.

This won't be easy, these outlaws showed our pilot no mercy. You'll need to take them out first before getting the cargo back. Fly safe,

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: Danger: Contraband Weapons Inbound
missions.overview:
This is a general warning. We have learned that the Headhunters are transporting a large amount of weapons into the system with the intent of launching attacks against CFP-owned settlements.

While we believe that change can only come to this system through nonviolence. The presence of these weapons will undoubtedly cause considerably more bloodshed and devastation so we want to remove them from the equation.

Any of our supporters with appropriate combat training are asked to undertake this dangerous assignment out near [LOCATION]. We will compensate you for the tremendous risk you are taking.

Thank you and be safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.description_lore:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.name: Dangerous Ambush
missions.overview:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A high profile client recently lost an important shipment when a pilot double-crossed them and ran off with their product. After weeks of hunting we’ve discovered that they were connected with an outlaw pack, so the client is looking to us to deter similar future issues from arising. The ultimate target is the pilot of a <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>, who leads the crew responsible. This won’t be easy. They don’t go anywhere without escort fighters and sub-capital ships. That’s why we highly recommend that you find a trusted friend or two who can handle this with you.  
  
Intel gathered by our analysts indicates that they frequently fly by an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> near <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> which would provide an excellent area to stage a surprise strike.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. We’re also adding a bonus payment of <EM4>12 MG Scrip</EM4> that’ll go to the main contractor.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

-Bit Zeros

The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [RewardValue_Wanted1] UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!



* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

missions.overview:
Call me Twitch. I run the Dead Saints. 

I doubt this is the first time you've heard of us, but in case you haven't, we do a lot of things, but one of them is transporting goods that need discreet handling. 

I got your info from one of my contacts. They say you've got the stuff we like in a hauler, which works for me, because we're looking for one. 

Here's my proposal – we're offering creds to the pilot that can transport some special cargo for us. Your ship’s hold will need room for <EM4>16 SCU cargo containers</EM4>, and you'll need a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> for loading and unloading. All you have to do is get everything from <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> without getting security involved. 
 
If you can pull the job off, the Saints will have more contracts for you down the line. 

-Twitch

ABOUT THE JOB
While your past performance has not been to our standards, microTech Protection Services has decided to offer you a chance to redeem yourself. 

To reevaluate your skills, we would like you to apprehend [TargetName] from [Location|Address].

While there will be other criminals at the site, your main focus should be on completing the bounty.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [Location|Address].
• Neutralize [TargetName]; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Bounty Hunters Guild membership and appropriate certification.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

missions.name: DEAD SAINTS -- Rookie Rank, Small Scale Cargo Run
missions.overview:
Got an interesting one. Some folks who were suckered into life/labor contracts with Hurston Dynamics want to get as far from Lorville as they possibly can. They struck a deal with a people mover and got themselves put on ice. Now they just need someone to pick them up and give them a ride. 

If you're up for some popsicle smuggling, you'll find [TOTAL] cryopods at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> that need to go to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. Make sure you have space in your cargo hold for size <EM4>2 SCU</EM4> containers. If you use a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>, you should be able to get everyone loaded up before Hurston security catches on. 

HD isn't too keen on anyone slipping out of their contracts, so watch your back. They shoot to kill. 

If you can pull this off, there's a nice paycheck in it for you.

-Twitch

missions.description_lore:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.

This introductory contract will require you to head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.

Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>Levski</EM4>.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.

This introductory contract will require you to head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.

Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>Levski</EM4>.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

missions.description_lore:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [RewardValue_Wanted1] UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!



* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

missions.name: Ling Nyx VeryHard RecoverCargo
missions.overview:
Hey,

Need a reliable contractor to help us out with a bit of a situation.

Our of our haulers has dropped out mid-contract and now our client's cargo is stuck in transit. Think they were trying to negotiate a better rate with us, but that's not how Ling does business. Anyway, they're done and we desperately need the shipment finished.

Petra and I have been working with this client for years now and have built up a good rapport. Be a shame to throw that all a way because of an unreliable hauler. Can you head to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and collect the shipment? You'll need a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a ship that can carry <EM4>[MAX_SCU] cargo containers</EM4>.

Take the shipment to the freight elevator over at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> and we'll get you paid as soon as. We'd really appreciate your help with this and I'm sure our client would too.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling 

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

missions.description_lore:
Normally, I like to cook everything from scratch myself. Pride in product and all. But every once in a while, whether it's too much demand or too much heat or whatever, I need to rely on other labs for an order. 

My hands are tied up here though, so I could use someone to help oversee the whole production line for me. Couldn't think of anyone better and more available than you.

* TO-DO LIST *

1. PROCESSING - Take the raw material from  [Pickup1|Address] to [Pickup2|Address]
2. PACKAGING - Take the refined product from  [Pickup2|Address] to [Pickup3|Address]
3. DISTRIBUTION - Take the finished goods from  [Pickup3|Address] to [DropOff1|Address]

Just don't get distracted in the middle and wander off. It happens more often than you'd think. Manage to finish the full list, and I'll see to it you get nice cut of the profits.

-Wallace

missions.name: Destroy Dangerous Drugs
missions.overview:
Reports of a spike in drug overdoses around Stanton has security services worried. Seems like some two-bit crew is juicing their profits by cutting their stuff with toxic chemicals. Shutting down this crew and stopping the distribution of their drugs has become a top priority.

A Foxwell informant has revealed that part of this crew has currently set up shop at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Hiring a contractor to hustle over there and destroy whatever drugs they’ve got stashed before they’re spread across the system. Better be careful though, word is this crew is armed to the teeth and determined to profit off that poison no matter what.

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

Vaughn

missions.name: Destroy Illegal Drugs
missions.overview:
We’ve been contracted to take care of a problem at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. There’s been a recent surge of activity in the area tied to the drug trade. It appears to be a well-run operation and there’s a growing concern that it’ll expand wider if not stopped. Any chance you’re available to make sure that doesn’t happen?   

Job is pretty straightforward. Head to the site and destroy their stash of drugs. That way they won’t have the creds to expand their operations any further. I wouldn’t expect them to make this easy on you though. Armed guards are regularly seen around the facility, so be sure you’ve got enough gear to deal with them too. 

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.description_lore:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [RewardValue_Wanted1] UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!



* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

This should at least provide us with enough of a reprieve for them to reconsider their offensive.

Thank you,
 
Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

missions.description_lore:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

We got a bit of a problem that I'm hoping you can solve for me. One of our informers has revealed that XenoThreat has been amassing data on Citizens for Prosperity operations throughout the system. 

This information, if used correctly, could put our people at serious risk. The best solution is for you to completely destroy the servers where the data is being stored at [LOCATION].

With their trove of information wiped out, it should give our people a fighting chance.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name: Disable Headhunter Comm Towers
missions.overview:
Violence is never our first choice, but sometimes it must be used as a preventative measure.

We’re planning a strike on a Headhunter controlled outpost and need your help.

We need to make sure that if something goes wrong they won’t be able to call for backup and escalate the situation. That’s where you come in. We need you to head over to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and disable the communication towers. There should be a <EM4>control panel located at the top</EM4> of each tower that you can use to deactivate them.

If you’re able to do this, Citizens for Prosperity will be able to gain some vital ground in Pyro.

It’s also worth keeping in mind for future contracts that you can choose to take out the comms towers instead of risking a fight with reinforcement dropships.

Stay alert and stay safe.

Thank you,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Vaughn

missions.name: Easy Pickings
missions.overview:
Get this, we were sifting through some comms and picked up some excitement about a big score. It was easy work to figure out where they're hiding a ship loaded with cargo and we figured, hey, why keep this profitable knowledge to ourselves? 

Send us a few creds in finder fees and we'll send you the coordinates of the asteroid base where the ship is stashed. It’s locked inside a hangar, so you’ll need to get to it via the station’s elevators. But once inside, you’ll be able to override the lockdown at a console. Do that and it should be easy pickings.

missions.overview:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Vanduul
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship
Briefing: InterSec requires the services of a skilled pilot who’s prepared to assist in taking down a dangerous Vanduul target that has been involved in numerous attacks.

Vanduul incursions have been on the rise recently, posing not only a threat to the system of Nyx, but the UEE as a whole. It is imperative that these sightings are responded to in a swift and efficient manner. 

We require you to fly to the last known sighting of the Vanduul ship at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and eliminate them immediately.  

Vanduul pilots are highly skilled and extremely dangerous. Engage the enemy immediately and do not hesitate – they will not show the same mercy.

Compensation proportionate to the risk of the contract will be awarded.

Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

Vaughn

missions.description_lore:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [RewardValue_Wanted1] UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!



* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

missions.description_lore:
Normally, I like to cook everything from scratch myself. Pride in product and all. But every once in a while, whether it's too much demand or too much heat or whatever, I need to rely on other labs for an order. 

My hands are tied up here though, so I could use someone to help oversee the whole production line for me. Couldn't think of anyone better and more available than you.

* TO-DO LIST *

1. PROCESSING - Take the raw material from  [Pickup1|Address] to [Pickup2|Address]
2. PACKAGING - Take the refined product from  [Pickup2|Address] to [Pickup3|Address]
3. DISTRIBUTION - Take the finished goods from  [Pickup3|Address] to [DropOff1|Address]

Just don't get distracted in the middle and wander off. It happens more often than you'd think. Manage to finish the full list, and I'll see to it you get nice cut of the profits.

-Wallace

missions.name: Finish the job
missions.overview:
One of our pilots was supposed to bring a shipment back to us, but seems like he got into some trouble over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Either he got his brains blasted all over the cockpit, or freaked out and ditched his ship. For his sake, I hope it’s the first one so I don’t have the hunt this asshole down. What’s important right now is that our cargo’s just sitting out there.

If you’ve got a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a decent ship, can you head over there and get our stuff? Chances are the assholes who attacked my pilot are still there, and I’m betting they’re pretty tough.

If you get out alive, take the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll get you paid.

Stows out.

Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.name: Finishing The Job
missions.overview:
One of my haulers has run into some trouble over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and was forced to ditch their ship. I need someone to go there with <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to grab the cargo and finish the job.

They were carrying a decent supply of gear for me, and the last thing I need is for some do-gooder to come across it and trace it back to us.

If you do run into anybody, no need to be friendly. Just shoot the asshole and get my gear. Understood?

Take it to the freight elevator over at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> and I’ll make sure you get a cut of the sale.

-Twitch

missions.name: Finishing The Job
missions.overview:
We got a situation. Some gang that no one’s heard of are trying to make a name for themselves by targeting our transport ships. They think they can make a big show of how tough they are raiding our haulers and acting like they’re big shots. Amateurs.

Problem is, they got lucky during their last attack. Our pilot barely made it out alive, but their ship is still sitting full of supplies over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>.

Grab a crew you can trust and your <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and get your ass over there.

After, drop the gear off at the freight elevator in <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. You do this for me and I’ll give you a good cut of the sale.

-Twitch

missions.description_lore:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

missions.name: First Haul in System
missions.overview:
Welcome to the system, not sure if you're familiar with our organization but Citizens for Prosperity are a non-profit organization dedicated to bringing security and civilization to unclaimed systems.

If you're looking for work in the system and would like to help achieve our goal, we need a package picked up from <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and taken to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

Once complete, we can offer you a variety of new job opportunities in this system and beyond.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.description_lore:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [RewardValue_Wanted1] UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!



* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

missions.overview: Hello, practicing on making ship fly better. Xi'an help human make ship. Fly good. Salvage good. But Wikelo can make better if you want. Bring things and will do. Bye.

missions.name: Vaughn Nyx Assassination Medium 0
missions.overview:
It seems the People’s Alliance have been ruffling some feathers recently. A client of ours would be most thrilled if you can prevent [TARGET] from meddling in their affairs ever again.

You’ll find them around <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>, and from what our client has told us, it’s unlikely that they’re alone. These aren’t your run-of-the-mill pilots, they might even pose a slight threat to your safety.

Do try your best to keep it as clean as possible.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

Bye.

missions.name: Gather Irradiated Valakkar Fangs
missions.overview:
To all available contractors,

We at Rayari are dedicating all our energy to stopping the regeneration technology crisis in its tracks, but to continue their efforts our scientists need materials that the company's suppliers cannot obtain. 

Rayari is seeking an experienced contractor to gather <EM4>irradiated valakkar fangs</EM4>, which can be extracted from adult valakkar that have been extensively exposed to radiation. Our scans have uncovered the existence of a qualifying population inside the storm near <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. 

Because these animals are highly dangerous, Rayari is offering premium pay to anyone who can assist with collecting the fangs.  

Once attained, please take these valuable resources to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

My gut says the pilot’s been ghosted. They knew how to handle a ship well, so the scavs that took them out must be decent. When you get my three packages back, take them to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> for me and I’ll wire you the creds.

-Twitch

missions.name: Getting Our Goods Back
missions.overview:
We’ve been using the old Hathor <EM4>[LOCATION1]</EM4> and <EM4>[LOCATION2]</EM4> as stashes, but it turns out some over-eager nullbrains sniffed them out and are trying to boost our shit for their own.

Luckily, the goods are still there - for now. We need someone to visit that PAF and OLP, grab our stuff from the freight elevators, and take it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> where we should be able to keep it on ice. 

Here’s the list of what to grab. Don’t care what order you do ‘em in. Be sure to bring a ship that can store <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> at the very least. 

- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]
- [LOCATION 3]

Make sure you’re ready to deal with whatever assholes you run across. A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

Oh and watch out for scavs, people are pretty desperate these days, even if it just some busted courier ship.

-Bit Zeros

The pilot’s ghosted, the ship’s busted, and it’s only a matter of time before they take my shit and leave. If you’re up for cracking these assholes, head to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and get my five packages.

Head’s up though, the pilot they ghosted was one of my best, so this crew’s got to be seriously kitted out. Bring your finest mates with you and show the bastards no mercy. Understood?

When you’re done, take the gear to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> and I’ll make sure you get a serious cut of the takings.

-Twitch

missions.overview:

Once inside, you’ll be able to use a console to override the lockdown to get everything out of there. We’ll happily sell you the coordinates, but the rest is up to you. 

Guess their loss will be our gain too.

missions.description_lore:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

-Stows

missions.description_lore:
Normally, I like to cook everything from scratch myself. Pride in product and all. But every once in a while, whether it's too much demand or too much heat or whatever, I need to rely on other labs for an order. 

My hands are tied up here though, so I could use someone to help oversee the whole production line for me. Couldn't think of anyone better and more available than you.

* TO-DO LIST *

1. PROCESSING - Take the raw material from  [Pickup1|Address] to [Pickup2|Address]
2. PACKAGING - Take the refined product from  [Pickup2|Address] to [Pickup3|Address]
3. DISTRIBUTION - Take the finished goods from  [Pickup3|Address] to [DropOff1|Address]

Just don't get distracted in the middle and wander off. It happens more often than you'd think. Manage to finish the full list, and I'll see to it you get nice cut of the profits.

-Wallace

missions.description_lore:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [RewardValue_Wanted1] UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!



* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

missions.overview:

A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.

This introductory contract will require you to head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.

Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>Levski</EM4>.

Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

missions.name: Inmate Maintenance Opportunity
missions.overview:
Hello Guests,

We have recently been alerted that one of our Oxygen Dispensers has suffered a technical error. As you know these kiosks are vital to ensure that you have plenty of oxygen handy while participating in our Work Release Program.

We are looking for any available guest to reset the kiosk. That should reconnect the kiosk to the network and resolve the issue. The first guest who's able to complete this task will not only be compensated with merits, but also with the satisfaction that they're making the workplace safer for other guests.

Thank you.

missions.overview:
Life is tough on the frontier, and every delivery to our settlers is important. We really can't afford to lose any more this year.

One of our key suppliers has been hit by a group of outlaws over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and gone silent on us. I fear the worst, but if we can still recover the supplies they were transporting, it could make a huge difference.

Chances are the outlaws who attacked them are still lurking around there so be on your guard. Once you've dealt with them, grab the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. Make sure you're flying a ship that can carry <EM4>[MAX_SCU] cargo containers</EM4> and bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> too.

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

missions.description_lore:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [RewardValue_Wanted1] UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!



* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

missions.name: RoX SWA
missions.overview:
Multiple reports are coming in of XenoThreat ships massing at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>
We're looking for contractors ready to take the fight to them. 

They want us to believe that they have right on their side. They want us to believe that they have overwhelming force. This is a chance to show them we know better.

I won't lie, this is more than just a simple security contract to me. I really hate those intolerant assholes and everything they stand for.

You with me?

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.description_lore:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

Now that Crusader’s found their fleet, it seems the Nine Tails finally realized just how useful a bit of extra help can be.

Long story short, they’re looking for some hired muscle to keep Crusader at bay. You’ll and everyone else who volunteers get a payout for every security ship you take down.

missions.name: Jorrit Dossier: Onyx Personnel Files
missions.overview:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
A client has requested that Hockrow compile a complete dossier on infamous scientist <EM4>Dr. Logan Jorrit</EM4>. Believed responsible for the incidents at Associated Science & Development’s Lazarus site, the client is eager to get a broader view of Dr. Logan and his research.

Contract Investigator Actions: 
Gain access to ASD’s shuttered <EM4>Onyx Facility</EM4> where Dr. Jorrit was formerly the Lead Scientist.  Once there, locate and <EM4>access the research lab’s personnel files</EM4> so that we can get an overview of what was going on there.

Additional Notes:
The QT beacon to the site was deactivated when the facility went dark so you'll have to fly the last leg manually.

While ASD has formally closed the facility, caution is still advised. Not only may the labs themselves be hazardous, but the surrounding area shows signs of recent visitors. Scavengers or squatters may be on site.

I've also managed to wrangle an employee ID code for you so as long as you're on the job, you'll be able to access the computers there. 

Additionally, Onyx Facility only has large hangars available, so plan your travel appropriately.

missions.name: Jorrit Dossier: Project Hyperion
missions.overview:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
All your digging around Onyx has paid off. I’ve been able to confirm that Jorrit has been operating an off-the-record lab in the facility’s Site-B in order to conduct an experiment he calls “Project Hyperion.” I’ll send his <EM4>lab notes to your mobiGlas journal</EM4> once you’re underway, but the long and short of it is the bastard is trying to make Humans evolve or some nonsense like that.

The client wants the experimental data, so you’re going back to Onyx and do everything needed to get Project Hyperion up and running. 

Contract Investigator Actions:
Prep the experiment by collecting a <EM4>Reagent code from the Engineering wing</EM4> and a <EM4>Catalyst code from the Research wing</EM4>.

Once you have those, head down to the <EM4>Lab in Site-B</EM4> and <EM4>run the experiment</EM4> so you can <EM4>upload the results</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Since this is an active lab, there might be ASD security on-site.
 
Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

missions.description_lore:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.name: Junior Hauler Needed for Direct Medium Shipment
missions.overview:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
