missions.description_lore:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.

This introductory contract will require you to head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.

Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>Levski</EM4>.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

missions.overview:

missions.description_lore:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [RewardValue_Wanted1] UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!

missions.name: Knock Out New Drug Op
missions.overview:
Some folks will do anything for a few creds. There’s a group of upstart outlaws over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> that have decided to start manufacturing drugs. Turns out they’re not too good at it, or maybe a little too good. The junk they’re pumping out is stronger than the normal stuff and a real danger to anyone who uses it. 

We’ve been hired to knock out their operation and destroy whatever drugs stashes are on site. Armed guards are protecting the place, but they don’t seem too skilled. Our surveillance teams observed one of them almost shoot himself in the foot. Can’t say for certain, but odds are they won’t give a pro like you too many problems.  

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.description_lore:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.

This introductory contract will require you to head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.

Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>Levski</EM4>.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

Normally, I like to cook everything from scratch myself. Pride in product and all. But every once in a while, whether it's too much demand or too much heat or whatever, I need to rely on other labs for an order. 

My hands are tied up here though, so I could use someone to help oversee the whole production line for me. Couldn't think of anyone better and more available than you.

* TO-DO LIST *

1. PROCESSING - Take the raw material from  [Pickup1|Address] to [Pickup2|Address]
2. PACKAGING - Take the refined product from  [Pickup2|Address] to [Pickup3|Address]
3. DISTRIBUTION - Take the finished goods from  [Pickup3|Address] to [DropOff1|Address]

Just don't get distracted in the middle and wander off. It happens more often than you'd think. Manage to finish the full list, and I'll see to it you get nice cut of the profits.

-Wallace

missions.name: Little Heavy Lifting at [DESTINATION]
missions.overview:
Got a bunch of boxes sitting at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> that have to be moved to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. Seems easy enough, right? Well, guess it ain’t. 

The idiot who was supposed to move these things threw out his back trying to carry all of ‘em at once. So, you know, maybe bring a <EM4> handheld tractor beam</EM4> and try taking ‘em one at a time like a normal person. But, hey, don’t let me tell you how to do your job. Just get it done. 

Stows out.

Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim.

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

- Stows

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [RewardValue_Wanted1] UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!



* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

missions.name: DeadSaints Stanton Super RecoverCargo
missions.overview:
A rival crew was able to get their hands on our delivery routes and now they have one of my cargo ships pinned down at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>.

Now the ship’s sitting there being guarded by a full crew of these assholes. They must be waiting for someone to show up with a transport ship, but you’re going to get there first.

Head there with a crew of your own and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to take the goods away. Make sure they’re the best people you got. It’d be a mistake to underestimate these bastards.

Ghost them and bring my cargo back to the freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> and I’ll make sure you’re seriously comp’d for this.

-Twitch

missions.description_lore:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

missions.description_lore:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.name: Luminalia 1
missions.overview:
Happy Luminalia!

I have a huge favor to ask. Thanks to some very ill timed maintenance issues, my ship is out of commission for at least a week and I won't be able to finish delivering presents to everyone on my gift list.

Looked into using FTL but with their holiday pricing I'll end up paying more credits than what the gifts cost! 

Figured I would see if you're interested in helping me out. I get my gifts delivered on time and you get some extra Luminalia spending credits. 

The gifts are wrapped and waiting at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. [DESCRIPTIONSETUP].

Thanks in advance and may your light glow a little brighter this year!

Sincerely,
[GIFTSENDER]

missions.description_lore:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [RewardValue_Wanted1] UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!



* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [RewardValue_Wanted1] UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!



* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

missions.name: Making the Most of a Bad Situation
missions.overview:
Just got a comm from the pilot who was transporting some gear for me and it sounded like they got jumped while on the call. I need someone to head to their location, grab the four packages that are still left inside their ship and bring them back to me.

Before they cut out, they told me that the ships that attacked them weren’t your standard transporters. These assholes are rocking some serious weaponry. Bring a crew, get my shit, and take it to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>. This whole thing is such a mess that I’d be willing to fork out some extra creds if you can get this done.

-Twitch

Narina Lerrem

Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.

This introductory contract will require you to head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.

Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>Levski</EM4>.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

missions.description_lore:
I've been conscripted to provide a trigger pull for a very motivated client. The target is <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4>, a loathsome character by all accounts who's seemed to relish the temporary authority that their mercenary position affords them. They believe their sadism to be righteous and my client would like to remind them otherwise.

They have recently been hired by ASD as part of a mercenary team at <EM4>[Location]</EM4>, so it won't be an easy approach as there will undoubtedly be other armed individuals. I'll expect you to react accordingly, but [TargetName|Last] is your target.

You will be paid upon completion.

All the best,

Vaughn

missions.description_lore:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.description_lore:
--------------------------------------------------------
----------------- BOUNTY CONTRACT -----------------
--------------------------------------------------------

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
PROCESSING & DISTRIBUTION

The Bounty Hunters Guild has authorized an official bounty.

NAME: [TargetName] 
SYSTEM: [System] 
RISK ASSESSMENT: Very High
LAST KNOWN LOCATION: [Location]
KNOWN AFFILIATIONS: <None>
NOTES: With your proven track record, the Bounty Hunters Guild would like to offer you the chance to earn an Advanced Tracker License.

This license would signify that you are qualified to track and apprehend Very High-Risk Targets (VHRT). These criminals can travel in larger multicrew ships with heavy escorts. With multiple hostiles to deal with, encounters with these targets can often be lethal.

To successfully complete this certification process, you must apprehend a VHRT ranked criminal by the name of <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4> last seen at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.


BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
In Pursuit of Justice

The Bounty Hunters Guild is a security service sanctioned by the Mercenary Guild and authorized to operate in both the UEE and beyond in accordance with Xenotrade Authority Acts.

missions.description_lore:
ABOUT THE JOB
While your past performance has not been to our standards, microTech Protection Services has decided to offer you a chance to redeem yourself. 

To reevaluate your skills, we would like you to apprehend [TargetName] from [Location|Address].

While there will be other criminals at the site, your main focus should be on completing the bounty.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [Location|Address].
• Neutralize [TargetName]; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Bounty Hunters Guild membership and appropriate certification.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

missions.description_lore:
Normally, I like to cook everything from scratch myself. Pride in product and all. But every once in a while, whether it's too much demand or too much heat or whatever, I need to rely on other labs for an order. 

My hands are tied up here though, so I could use someone to help oversee the whole production line for me. Couldn't think of anyone better and more available than you.

* TO-DO LIST *

1. PROCESSING - Take the raw material from  [Pickup1|Address] to [Pickup2|Address]
2. PACKAGING - Take the refined product from  [Pickup2|Address] to [Pickup3|Address]
3. DISTRIBUTION - Take the finished goods from  [Pickup3|Address] to [DropOff1|Address]

Just don't get distracted in the middle and wander off. It happens more often than you'd think. Manage to finish the full list, and I'll see to it you get nice cut of the profits.

-Wallace

Vaughn

If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

Vaughn

missions.name: Need a Hauler
missions.overview:
Hi, we need to move some cargo across the system and were wondering if you could help. I know this is outside your usual purview, but I'm low on options. This would also be a great way to show your committed to Citizens for Prosperity's greater mission here.

If you head to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>, there should be some cargo accessible via a freight elevator that we'll need you to take to another freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

Only thing to call out is that your ship must be able to handle <EM4>4 SCU cargo containers</EM4>. To make your life easier, be sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. Otherwise, it should be a simple run. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.description_lore:
Normally, I like to cook everything from scratch myself. Pride in product and all. But every once in a while, whether it's too much demand or too much heat or whatever, I need to rely on other labs for an order. 

My hands are tied up here though, so I could use someone to help oversee the whole production line for me. Couldn't think of anyone better and more available than you.

* TO-DO LIST *

1. PROCESSING - Take the raw material from  [Pickup1|Address] to [Pickup2|Address]
2. PACKAGING - Take the refined product from  [Pickup2|Address] to [Pickup3|Address]
3. DISTRIBUTION - Take the finished goods from  [Pickup3|Address] to [DropOff1|Address]

Just don't get distracted in the middle and wander off. It happens more often than you'd think. Manage to finish the full list, and I'll see to it you get nice cut of the profits.

-Wallace

missions.name: Need Resource for Research
missions.overview:
To all available contractors,

Our research team at at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> is working tirelessly on solving the current ‘Regen Crisis’ and addressing the issue of unstable imprints. Their work has produced promising results, but a lack of a key resource is impeding their ability to run further experiments. 

We’ve received word from our supplier that increased demand combined with lower mining yields means that we won’t receive our scheduled shipment for another few months. Our research team can’t wait that long, and we’re hoping you can help.      

The resource is hard to come by, but we have it on good authority that the old Hathor mining facilities were built in areas with a high concentration of the ore. Since Hathor went defunct not long after establishing their operations in- system, there’s a good chance that activating one of these mining lasers could provide you with what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

Vaughn

missions.description_lore:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

I have a very specific task that requires my best people. 

Something unusual seems to have occurred over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. One of our contractors seems to have gone rogue after completing their assignment, refusing to communicate with us, and indiscriminately attacking those they come across. Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim.

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

Been getting word that CFP security have been getting a little more aggressive and started pushing people out of the homes they've built out of the scrap in the system and they want payback, so they came to us.

Head out to [Location|Address] and clear out the CFP there. Should be pretty cut and dry with a nice payday.

missions.name: HaulCargo AToB Nyx Small Medical Intro
missions.overview:
Earning such accolades as 'Imperial Finances' Top 10 Shipping Companies' and 'Delivery Digest's 2945's Most Trusted Transport,' Covalex is busier than ever. And that means more cargo going to more places. That's where you come in.  

Covalex is looking for dependable and industrious pilots to join our expanding family. Do you have access to a ship that can hold <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4>? Can you pass an Advocacy background check if required? Then a universe of opportunity is waiting for you. 

Simply complete an 'Evaluation Trial’ by picking up a shipment of <EM4>[ITEM]</EM4> from a freight elevator at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and successfully delivering it to a freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

Upon satisfactory completion, you'll be eligible to become part of Covalex Shipping's vast network of independent transport specialists*.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.   

Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

*Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

missions.description_lore:
Normally, I like to cook everything from scratch myself. Pride in product and all. But every once in a while, whether it's too much demand or too much heat or whatever, I need to rely on other labs for an order. 

My hands are tied up here though, so I could use someone to help oversee the whole production line for me. Couldn't think of anyone better and more available than you.

* TO-DO LIST *

1. PROCESSING - Take the raw material from  [Pickup1|Address] to [Pickup2|Address]
2. PACKAGING - Take the refined product from  [Pickup2|Address] to [Pickup3|Address]
3. DISTRIBUTION - Take the finished goods from  [Pickup3|Address] to [DropOff1|Address]

Just don't get distracted in the middle and wander off. It happens more often than you'd think. Manage to finish the full list, and I'll see to it you get nice cut of the profits.

-Wallace

Once on site, engage and destroy any hostiles you encounter and protect the client. Once they've transferred the credits, we'll route you your payment.

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement

In Pursuit of Justice

missions.name: Orange Level Contract: Handle Security Threat
missions.overview:
After a contractor successfully recovered data stolen from one of our clients, a security analyst verified that it was captured by unauthorized surveillance monitors illegally installed around <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. We’re looking for someone to follow up and take out those monitors.

You will need to find the <EM4>[MONITOR_COUNT]</EM4> and destroy them before any more data can be gathered. Passive 'Skimmers' like these typically are hard to find so be thorough in your search.

Once attacked, their security protocols will cause them to begin transmitting the contents of their drives, so it’s imperative that you stop the upload before it can complete. There’s also a good chance that whoever’s responsible might be in the area, so be careful.

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.name: Orange Level Contract: Return the Favor
missions.overview:
Recently, a <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> baited Foxwell forces with a bogus rescue beacon. By the time our forces realized what was happening, a squad of ships unleashed a devastating attack and only one Foxwell contractor survived. Their scan logs identified the bait ship, and we’ve had scouts monitoring them ever since.

Our surveillance has revealed the squad has a regular flight pattern that we think we can exploit. There’s a sizable emission cloud at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> that makes it an ideal spot to post up. Think you have what it takes to handle this for us? 

It’ll be you against the <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>, other large craft, and a sizable escort. Wish I could be more specific than that but this crew regularly rotates ships in and out of the squad. Would be smart to bring some support, so you don’t get overwhelmed by their numbers.   

Complete the job and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of <EM4>8 MG Scrip</EM4>.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

We’ve got clients reporting outlaw attacks on ships around <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. They got locked down tight and anybody heading in or out is a target. Any attempts to solve the issue have just been met with more outlaw reinforcements appearing. 

The client is desperate for a solution, so we’re hiring a contractor to go and restore peace in the area. If any other issues flare up once you're there, I’ll comm you directions on how to help.  

Really need someone on this fast. So to sweeten the pot, the main contractor will also get a bonus payment of <EM4>5 MG Scrip</EM4>.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.description_lore:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is in need of new qualified bounty hunters to expand our existing roster. To evaluate your skills, we would like you to assist us in the apprehension of [TargetName] from [Location|Address].

While there will be other criminals at the site, your main focus should be on completing the bounty.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [Location|Address].
• Neutralize [TargetName]; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Bounty Hunters Guild membership and appropriate certification.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

missions.name: Orange Level Contract: Spring a Trap
missions.overview:
Foxwell has been tracking a <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> used by outlaws and discovered a pattern to its movements. The ship should be passing by <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> soon.

Looking for a contractor willing to hustle there, hide in the emission cloud, and then spring the trap when the time is right. There’s usually escort ships with the <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>. Careful not to jump the gun and blow your cover. The element of surprise is crucial from what I’ve read.

Pull this off and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of <EM4>5 MG Scrip</EM4>.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.description_lore:
Normally, I like to cook everything from scratch myself. Pride in product and all. But every once in a while, whether it's too much demand or too much heat or whatever, I need to rely on other labs for an order. 

My hands are tied up here though, so I could use someone to help oversee the whole production line for me. Couldn't think of anyone better and more available than you.

* TO-DO LIST *

1. PROCESSING - Take the raw material from  [Pickup1|Address] to [Pickup2|Address]
2. PACKAGING - Take the refined product from  [Pickup2|Address] to [Pickup3|Address]
3. DISTRIBUTION - Take the finished goods from  [Pickup3|Address] to [DropOff1|Address]

Just don't get distracted in the middle and wander off. It happens more often than you'd think. Manage to finish the full list, and I'll see to it you get nice cut of the profits.

-Wallace

missions.overview:
It seems that a couple of different small-time gangs have decided to pool their resources and start doing coordinated attacks. Alone, they weren't much, but all together they're proving to be a serious threat that has to be dealt with.

Recruit some backup you can rely on and the fly over to [LOCATION]. Once you attack the initial gang members you find there, the other groups will arrive to support them. Make sure you wait around to take out all of them.
 
Good luck,

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement

missions.description_lore:
--------------------------------------------------------
----------------- BOUNTY CONTRACT -----------------
--------------------------------------------------------

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
PROCESSING & DISTRIBUTION

The Bounty Hunters Guild has authorized an official bounty.

NAME: [TargetName] 
SYSTEM: [System] 
RISK ASSESSMENT: Very High
LAST KNOWN LOCATION: [Location]
KNOWN AFFILIATIONS: <None>
NOTES: With your proven track record, the Bounty Hunters Guild would like to offer you the chance to earn an Advanced Tracker License.

This license would signify that you are qualified to track and apprehend Very High-Risk Targets (VHRT). These criminals can travel in larger multicrew ships with heavy escorts. With multiple hostiles to deal with, encounters with these targets can often be lethal.

To successfully complete this certification process, you must apprehend a VHRT ranked criminal by the name of <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4> last seen at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.


BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
In Pursuit of Justice

The Bounty Hunters Guild is a security service sanctioned by the Mercenary Guild and authorized to operate in both the UEE and beyond in accordance with Xenotrade Authority Acts.

missions.name: FoxwellEnforcement BombingRun Stanton M
missions.overview:
We're in need of a sharp contractor for a hit and run operation. Client says some local thugs have been congregating in concerning numbers and we have been tasked with disrupting their base of operations.

Get on over to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and take out their fuel tanks. If you're successful we can set these folks plans back a while, and most importantly, without having to deal with them directly.

Reports are showing there's a couple of ships buzzing around the area and some defense turrets. Just focus on the fuel tanks and you should be alright.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

All the best,

missions.description_lore:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

It will be your job to keep both safe at all costs. I don't have all the facts yet, but I reckon this will be a tough mission – these outlaws seem determined to do some real carnage. 

If it were me, I would <EM>bring backup</EM4> to deal with them. And if you manage to protect everyone, we’re offering a well-earned <EM4>4 MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor who deals with these lowlife's successfully. 

Best of luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.description_lore:
I've been conscripted to provide a trigger pull for a very motivated client. The target is <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4>, a loathsome character by all accounts who's seemed to relish the temporary authority that their mercenary position affords them. They believe their sadism to be righteous and my client would like to remind them otherwise.

They have recently been hired by ASD as part of a mercenary team at <EM4>[Location]</EM4>, so it won't be an easy approach as there will undoubtedly be other armed individuals. I'll expect you to react accordingly, but [TargetName|Last] is your target.

You will be paid upon completion.

All the best,

Vaughn

missions.name: Our Version of The Truth
missions.overview:
I’m not gonna give you the whole backstory of what this person has done to us, but all you need to know is that some scumbag is trying to get a payout for a ship crash and the insurance company wants to see the blackbox recording to make sure everything is “above board”.

We’re not gonna let that happen though.

Snatch that blackbox at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and bring it to us instead so we can do some “creative editing” on the recording.

Apparently, this area is a bit of a hot zone. Probably why they staged the accident there. You should probably bring some backup so you don’t get ghosted before you can bring the blackbox to us at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

-Bit Zeros

missions.name: Headhunters BombingRun Stanton S
missions.overview:
We've heard news that a new gang are planning an attack on a place over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. They figure if they can take out the fuel supplies there then it's theirs for the taking.

But little do they know that we're gonna send you in first to blow the fuel tanks so we can claim the place before they do. If it all goes to plan, we can clear the location out and stick it to that gang at the same time. Two birds, one stone.

Only problem is this place is armed to the teeth. Bring a crew and get those fuel tanks out of action. We'll take care of the rest.

-Stows out

missions.description_lore:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.name: Paid Target in CFP
missions.overview:
Headhunters are launching an attack near [LOCATION]. This ex-Marine asshole named [TARGET] has been sending their mercs to clear out nearby encampments if they don't surrender their weapons.

While all the security have been greenlit, [TARGET] has been singled out. In their last raid, they beat a squatter to death for talking back. Turns out that squatter was the cousin of one of our Clips, so they're paying extra to make sure justice is done.

Watch yourself though, [TARGET] may be a scumbag who has this coming, they're still ex-military so they won't be easy to take down.

-Stows

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec has received intelligence that outlaws are planning to launch an attack on a target within the UEE. In an effort to prevent this from happening, we need a contractor to patrol a sector we believe these outlaws are using to prepare for their attack.

Once you've confirmed that the entire sector is clear, the main contractor will receive a bonus of <EM4>14 MG Scrip.</EM4>

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

missions.description_lore:
Normally, I like to cook everything from scratch myself. Pride in product and all. But every once in a while, whether it's too much demand or too much heat or whatever, I need to rely on other labs for an order. 

My hands are tied up here though, so I could use someone to help oversee the whole production line for me. Couldn't think of anyone better and more available than you.

* TO-DO LIST *

1. PROCESSING - Take the raw material from  [Pickup1|Address] to [Pickup2|Address]
2. PACKAGING - Take the refined product from  [Pickup2|Address] to [Pickup3|Address]
3. DISTRIBUTION - Take the finished goods from  [Pickup3|Address] to [DropOff1|Address]

Just don't get distracted in the middle and wander off. It happens more often than you'd think. Manage to finish the full list, and I'll see to it you get nice cut of the profits.

-Wallace

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

missions.description_lore:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

I need you to travel to <EM4>Glaciem Ring Wreck Site</EM4> and see if our contractor, <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4>, is truly gone.

Vaughn

missions.name: Plug a traitor
missions.overview:
This shit saddens me. Not sure if you've ever crossed paths with [TARGET] in your dealings with us. Thought they were a real good one. Been with the Headhunters for years, but something must have happened because they went running to CFP for protection. Sold out some of our brothers and sisters along the way.

All the Judges are furious and wants blood. That's where you come in. Go to [LOCATION], find [TARGET], and kill them.

Doesn't have to be anything fancy. Just want the result.

Damn shame.

Stows out.

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

missions.name: Pro Tem Escapee Bounty Contract
missions.overview:
Hey There,

My name is Braden Corchado and I'm a logistics officer for Northrock Service Group, the leading independently-owned security firm operating in the Stanton system. I may have reached out already, but we try to make it a point of approaching anyone who meets our high standards and encouraging them to complete a pro tem contract. 

You can't do much better than become a Northrock contractor. We have a solid reputation for offering challenging and interesting work at a higher rate of pay then many of our competitors in system. 

Now, to get approved, you will need to apprehend one [TARGET]. They have recently escaped from the detention center and your job will be to track them down before they can disappear completely off the grid. 

A little hint is that it's safe to assume that the target is going to go try to clear their record. I recommend triangulating your search between the detention center they escaped from and locations where they can hack into the record system.

Get this done and we'll see about getting you more work.

Hope to hear from you soon, 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

Hope you don't mind, but I was made aware of your Bounty Hunters Guild status and wanted to reach out and see if you'd be interested in contracting with Northrock Service Group, one of the top rated private security firms in the system.

If you are, the first step would be to complete a pro tem suspect apprehension. It's less of an evaluation and more of a chance to make sure that we can have a good working relationship. 

The suspect you would be after is known as <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>. They are known to be particularly elusive so you may have your work cut out for you.

Hope to hear from you soon, 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

missions.description_lore:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.overview:

We know from past encounters that XenoThreat sends several raiding parties to carry out their attacks, so make sure you don’t leave the outpost until you’ve fought off all the reinforcements. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

We believe in you.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.description_lore:
Normally, I like to cook everything from scratch myself. Pride in product and all. But every once in a while, whether it's too much demand or too much heat or whatever, I need to rely on other labs for an order. 

My hands are tied up here though, so I could use someone to help oversee the whole production line for me. Couldn't think of anyone better and more available than you.

* TO-DO LIST *

1. PROCESSING - Take the raw material from  [Pickup1|Address] to [Pickup2|Address]
2. PACKAGING - Take the refined product from  [Pickup2|Address] to [Pickup3|Address]
3. DISTRIBUTION - Take the finished goods from  [Pickup3|Address] to [DropOff1|Address]

Just don't get distracted in the middle and wander off. It happens more often than you'd think. Manage to finish the full list, and I'll see to it you get nice cut of the profits.

-Wallace

A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

missions.name: RCD Contested 22
missions.overview:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS: 
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years. 

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser. 

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself. 

<EM4>TERMS*:</EM4>
We are making available the <EM4>shared mining rights</EM4> to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a <EM4>mining vessel</EM4>, restore the <EM4>station's mining laser</EM4> to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and <EM4>harvest the resources</EM4> inside. 

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a <EM4>first come, first serve</EM4> basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised. 

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

missions.description_lore:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [RewardValue_Wanted1] UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!



* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

missions.description_lore:
Normally, I like to cook everything from scratch myself. Pride in product and all. But every once in a while, whether it's too much demand or too much heat or whatever, I need to rely on other labs for an order. 

My hands are tied up here though, so I could use someone to help oversee the whole production line for me. Couldn't think of anyone better and more available than you.

* TO-DO LIST *

1. PROCESSING - Take the raw material from  [Pickup1|Address] to [Pickup2|Address]
2. PACKAGING - Take the refined product from  [Pickup2|Address] to [Pickup3|Address]
3. DISTRIBUTION - Take the finished goods from  [Pickup3|Address] to [DropOff1|Address]

Just don't get distracted in the middle and wander off. It happens more often than you'd think. Manage to finish the full list, and I'll see to it you get nice cut of the profits.

-Wallace

Vaughn

-Wallace

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

missions.overview:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws present and armed
Equipment Specs: <EM4>Cargo Capable Ship</EM4>, Personal Arms, <EM4>Heavy-Duty Tractor Beam</EM4>
Briefing: 
Our latest intel shows that the Shattered Blade have replenished their stock of Vanduul corpses and will shortly be transferring them from the old <EM4>QV Logistics station</EM4>they're operating from to an interested buyer. The UEE can't have another incident like what happened with ASD so they're eager for us to <EM4>recover the cryopods</EM4> and deliver them to <EM4>the freight elevator at [DESTINATION]</EM4>.

While the Shattered Blade members present at the site might offer resistance, they are not the focus of you mission. Deal with them as needed and get the cryopods. 

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager

missions.name: Covalex Nyx Super RecoverCargo
missions.overview:
Hey,

Only looking for contractors who are the best of the best for this one. One of our most valued clients is expecting an incredibly important shipment which is now seriously overdue.

Here at Covalex, we pride ourselves on treating all of our clients equally, offering outstanding levels of service regardless of what we're delivering. That being said, if we lose this contract someone's gonna be in hot water and I really can't afford for that person to be me.

The tracker is reporting that the last contractor's ship is over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Don't take any chances with this one, you'll need a ship that can hold <EM4>[MAX_SCU] cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to collect it all.

Deliver the shipment to the freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> and we can put this whole mess behind us. And you'll make a sizeable heap of credits in the process. Not bad, right?

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

Now that Crusader’s found their fleet, it seems the Nine Tails finally realized just how useful a bit of extra help can be.

Long story short, they’re looking for some hired muscle to keep Crusader at bay. You’ll and everyone else who volunteers get a payout for every security ship you take down. 

And on top of that, if all of you keep Crusader occupied long enough for the Nine Tails to finish up whatever the hell it is that they’re up to with this quantum blockade, you’ll get a big fat bonus.

missions.name: Red Level Contract: Ambush Attack Squad
missions.overview:
Foxwell got word from an important client that outlaws have put together a squad that’s been stalking the system with sub-capital ships and escort fighters. Our client is concerned that if left unchecked, outlaws will create more of these attack squads and destabilize system security. We’ve been hired to wipe out this group before that happens. 

We need a confident and skilled contractor for this task. Good news is that we have a plan in place. One of the ships used by this squad, a <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>, was stolen from our client, who’s still able to track its movements. They’ve shared the location data with us and we’ve discovered that this squad often goes by <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. We’ve scouted the location and discovered a large emission cloud makes an ideal spot for an ambush.  

Not going to lie, this isn’t going to be easy. We don’t have any additional forces available to deploy, so it would be good to bring your own support. 

You manage to pull this off, I've arranged for a bonus payment of <EM4>12 MG Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

While your past performance has not been to our standards, microTech Protection Services has decided to offer you a chance to redeem yourself.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Neutralize [TargetName]; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Bounty Hunters Guild membership and appropriate certification.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

missions.name: Red Level Contract: Surprise Attack
missions.overview:
We’ve received a handful of comms about recent attacks undertaken by an <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> and its escort ships. After opening a file, we started tracking the ship’s movements and noticed that it frequently passes an emission cloud near <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. We want to use that to our advantage to launch a surprise attack. 

Once on site, you should hide in the emission cloud to cloak your signature enough to allow you to make the first strike. Unfortunately, Foxwell can’t provide additional reinforcements for this operation, so you’ll be responsible for bringing any support forces. You might need the help too. The crew of the [TARGET] is aggressive and battle hardened.        

You get this taken care of for us and there's a bonus payment of <EM4>16 MG Scrip</EM4> in it for the main contractor.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Citizens for Prosperity

missions.description_lore:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

missions.description_lore:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.overview:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

We’re having trouble completing a hauling mission and need a reliable contractor who has experience working in dangerous environments to complete the job. Just as a heads up, the cargo is in an abandoned ship surrounded by multiple, highly dangerous outlaws. We strongly advise you bring some backup with you and <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to retrieve the client’s goods. Details follow:

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>

Since this is a bit risky, we’re offering proportionate pay. I’ll leave it up to you to decide how to distribute it to your crew.

TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.

-Wallace

missions.description_lore:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.

This introductory contract will require you to head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.

Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>Levski</EM4>.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.

Waiting to hear from you,

Dina Deloit

United Wayfarers Club

Hey there,

If you're fitted for refueling, you might like this one. 

A beacon has just gone live at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>, from a client whose <EM4>[SHIP]</EM4> is running on empty, so make sure your fuel pods are topped off.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FUELRATE] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>[QTFUELRATE] aUEC per SCU of Quantum </EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Looks like a zero-drama one and done, but it never hurts to keep your scanners live.
Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.

Waiting to hear from you,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

tactical_analysis.content: Quantum Nav Mode: Mantén escudos al 100% mientras cargas el motor para saltos rápidos.
Atmospheric Efficiency: Sube a 10km en ángulo de 45° antes de saltar en planetas con atmósfera.

missions.description_lore:
Citizens for Prosperity have entrenched themselves at [Pickup1|Address]. To keep them from getting too comfy at that station, we want to show them what life is really like in our system. We’ll pay you to hit the station, grab the [item], and kill anyone that gets in your way. 

Payment hinges on you delivering those supplies to [Dropoff1|Address]. Anyone you kill will just be a perk.     

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.description_lore:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [RewardValue_Wanted1] UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!



* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

missions.name: ShipWaveAttack ClearOutHostiles Nyx M
missions.overview:
It feels that whenever we start to make real progress in the system, the outlaws are there to push one step back. We had recently cleared out [LOCATION] only to learn that a new outlaw gang has taken root there, using it as a launching point for various criminal enterprises. 

Since we can't afford to let this rot spread, you and a few support ships are being charged with heading there to clear out all the gang's packs. After you deal with one pack, be sure to wait until all of the hostile packs have been dealt with.

Know that you are helping to make a real difference,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.description_lore:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.name: Reprisal Attack
missions.overview:
A squad of ships recently shanked one of our convoys, and ten credits says they’re gonna try and do it again. Looking for someone to launch a reprisal attack before that can happen.  

We’ve ID’d the idiots as consisting of several large craft and a sizable escort. We believe the leader is flying a <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> and set that ship as the primary target. Since it’s a sizable and aggressive squad, a surprise attack seems like a smart play. They often pass by <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>, which has an emission cloud to hide in. Be smart and patient then strike when the time is right. 

Unless you fancy yourself a real ace, it’s probably best to bring some friends. Maybe you can entice folks by letting them know they can pick through the wreckage for valuables once the deed is done.

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>8 Council Scrip</EM4> to sweeten the pot.

Stows out.

tactical_analysis.content: Quantum Offset: Salta a un OM cercano al objetivo primero. Inicia el combate a < 2km.
Desync Warning: En 4.7, las Valkyries enemigas teletransportan. No uses misiles a menos de 3km.
Ballistics Meta: Los AD5B siguen siendo intocables por su capacidad de penetración de escudos.

missions.name: Ling Nyx Medium RecoverCargo
missions.overview:
Hi,

Got a relatively straightforward one for you if you're interested.

One of our pilot ignored a maintenance warning and sure enough, a couple of hours later their ship broke down over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. They're on their way back to the office now but we could do with a reliable hauler whose got a ship big enough to transport <EM4>[MAX_SCU] cargo containers</EM4> to complete the haul for us.

Think you could help us out? You just need to pick up the stranded shipment and deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.  And I probably don't have to say this, but a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> would probably be handy to have along.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling 

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.description_lore:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.

This introductory contract will require you to head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.

Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>Levski</EM4>.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.overview:
Got word there’s a few ships near [LOCATION] just floating all by their lonesome. It’s good salvage, but none of our crews have the time right now. We figured to give you first snap at it.

Got another scumbag who needs their ticket punched. [TARGET] is just a low level thug who doesn't seem to learn. We've warned them to either throw in with us or move system, but they don't seem to be listening so we're out of patience.

Head to [LOCATION] and you should find [TARGET] flying around. 

Stows out.

Desync Warning: En 4.7, las Valkyries enemigas teletransportan. No uses misiles a menos de 3km.
Ballistics Meta: Los AD5B siguen siendo intocables por su capacidad de penetración de escudos.

missions.description_lore:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.description_lore:
It is with deep disappointment that I send this message. A peerless contractor of ours was out on a job, but it seems like the target may have gotten the better of them.

I need you to travel to <EM4>Glaciem Ring Wreck Site</EM4> and see if our contractor, <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4>, is truly gone.

I suspect that the location will be somewhat chaotic since there will most likely still be multiple threats on site. Therefore, a supporting crew is strongly advised.

Sincerely,

Vaughn

missions.name: Covalex Nyx Easy RecoverCargo
missions.overview:
Hiya,

I've got a client who's been messaging me all morning about a shipment they were supposed to receive and when I checked up on the cargo it turns out that it's sitting completely still in the middle of space.

This is obviously bad for a number of reasons, and not just because I had to spend 20 minutes getting yelled at. Can you head over to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and see what happened? The original contract called for a ship that could carry <EM4>[MAX_SCU] cargo containers</EM4> so make sure you've got that and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>.

Once you've got the cargo, can you make sure it's delivered to the freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>? Thanks a bunch.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

tactical_analysis.content: Quantum Nav Mode: Mantén escudos al 100% mientras cargas el motor para saltos rápidos.
Atmospheric Efficiency: Sube a 10km en ángulo de 45° antes de saltar en planetas con atmósfera.

missions.description_lore:
ABOUT THE JOB
While your past performance has not been to our standards, microTech Protection Services has decided to offer you a chance to redeem yourself. 

To reevaluate your skills, we would like you to apprehend [TargetName] from [Location|Address].

While there will be other criminals at the site, your main focus should be on completing the bounty.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [Location|Address].
• Neutralize [TargetName]; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Bounty Hunters Guild membership and appropriate certification.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

missions.name: Shubin RG Discovery FPSMine Nyx Rank1 MediumQuantity Sadaryx
missions.overview:
CONTRACT: Mining Order
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
One of our prospecting teams recently confirmed that the asteroids which house QV Breaker Stations throughout Nyx's Keeger Belt contain a rare ore type, Sadaryx.

However, owing to the difficulty in access these stations and the inherent risks involved, we are seeking external mining crews to handle the extraction.

We do not have a confirmed location of where the Sadaryx deposits are located within the station, but would recommend starting with the cave sections where minerals naturally form. If you get really lucky, you may even find some crystals in storage that were mined by the old QV work crews.

<EM4>TERMS*:</EM4>
Your crew will need to gain access to a <EM4>QV Breaker Station</EM4>, collect the required <EM4>Sadaryx ore</EM4>, and deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

This will require a <EM4>Multi-Tool with a Mining Attachment</EM4> and a basic understanding of hand mining.

Our prospecting teams have reported that these stations may have been infiltrated by outlaws. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

tactical_analysis.content: Operation Breaker (Nyx): Usa el monorraíl para llegar al Warehouse inmediatamente.
Sinergia Shubin: Sube a Rep 2 para desbloquear el Láser de Minería Masivo.
Equipa un traje térmico industrial. Las estaciones Breaker en Nyx tienen fugas de refrigerante.

missions.description_lore:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.

This introductory contract will require you to head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.

Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>Levski</EM4>.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

missions.description_lore:
I've been conscripted to provide a trigger pull for a very motivated client. The target is <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4>, a loathsome character by all accounts who's seemed to relish the temporary authority that their mercenary position affords them. They believe their sadism to be righteous and my client would like to remind them otherwise.

They have recently been hired by ASD as part of a mercenary team at <EM4>[Location]</EM4>, so it won't be an easy approach as there will undoubtedly be other armed individuals. I'll expect you to react accordingly, but [TargetName|Last] is your target.

You will be paid upon completion.

All the best,

Vaughn

missions.overview:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>[SYSTEM] </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Due to changes in our sourcing pipeline, Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to purchase a variety of refined materials from independent miners operating in the area. While selling at a trade hub may net you a more competitive price than fulfilling our order, many miners find that strengthening their ties to Shubin to be a wise long-term investment for their career.

[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal. I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
