missions.description_lore:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [RewardValue_Wanted1] UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!



* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

Payment hinges on you delivering those supplies to [Dropoff1|Address]. Anyone you kill will just be a perk.     

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.name: Space Patrol
missions.overview:
The local Clip wants current intel on several of our sectors. Not sure what they’re looking for but I’m not about to ask. My job is to find someone willing to swing through and scan these locations. You available? 

All you need to do is head to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD, run a scan, and if it’s clear, move to the next spot. If you run into any issues, take care of it. 

Ain’t sound too tough now does it? Plus, I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>8 Council Scrip</EM4> as thanks. 

Stows out.

tactical_analysis.content: Quantum Nav Mode: Mantén escudos al 100% mientras cargas el motor para saltos rápidos.
Atmospheric Efficiency: Sube a 10km en ángulo de 45° antes de saltar en planetas con atmósfera.

missions.description_lore:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a qualified bounty hunter to apprehend the extreme-risk target [TargetName] from [Location|Address]. 

An extreme-risk target typically pilots a sub-capital class vessel, has several heavily-armed allies, and is expected to be very difficult to apprehend. It may be useful to bring along support staff to assist with engaging this target.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [Location|Address].
• Neutralize [TargetName]; using force as necessary.

• Bounty Hunters Guild membership and appropriate certification.
• Access to vehicle suitably outfitted for combat.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

I need you to travel to <EM4>Glaciem Ring Wreck Site</EM4> and see if our contractor, <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4>, is truly gone.

Sincerely,

Vaughn

All the best,

Vaughn

missions.description_lore:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [RewardValue_Wanted1] UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!



* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

Foxwell Enforcement

The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

missions.overview:
Hey,

Just our luck that we land one of the biggest contracts of our life and our hauler's engines seize up. They've tried their best to fix it but seems like it's just not happening.

Can you fly out to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and grab the cargo for us? It's really important that we show our client that we're just as reliable as the other big players out there.

Just so you know this is a large shipment. You'll need a ship that can handle <EM4>[MAX_SCU] cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to move it all. Once you've transferred it to your ship, deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> and we'll send confirmation to the client.

Considering the circumstances, we're paying above market rates to whoever can complete this.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling 

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

missions.name: Shubin RG Discovery FPSMine Nyx Rank1 SadaryxLenses
missions.overview:
CONTRACT: Manufacturing Order
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
If you happen to have any other work bringing you to one of the QV Breaker Stations in the Keeger Belt, Shubin Interstellar would be highly interested in contracting you to obtaining a supply of hard-to-source mining laser focus lenses.

<EM4>TERMS*:</EM4>
While there may be some focus lenses that can be recovered from the QV Breaker Station's storage, you must likely will need to manufacture them using <EM4>Sadaryx crystals</EM4> and the on-site lens fabricator. While the ore is rare, these Breaker Stations typically have sadaryx veins that can be mined directly with a <EM4>Multi-Tool with a Mining Attachment</EM4>.

Deliver the procured lenses to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> for processing.

Contractors have reported that these stations may have been infiltrated by outlaws, so caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

missions.description_lore:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.

This introductory contract will require you to head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.

Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>Levski</EM4>.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

missions.name: Surprise Party
missions.overview:
Some numskull flying a <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> was caught spying on our ops. We ran ‘em off with a warning only to spot ‘em doing the same shit someplace else. Since they didn’t get the message, seems we gotta send a stronger one.    

There’s an emission cloud near <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> that they fly by frequently. Primo place to power down, hide, and launch a surprise attack. Sometimes they fly solo, sometimes there’s other single-seaters with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job. 

And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of <EM4>1 Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor at the end of the job. 

Stows out.

missions.name: Sweep and Clear Location
missions.overview:
Looking for someone willing to take out the trash at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. Guess a gang has settled in without the permission of the owners. So they’ve hired us to get them out whatever way we see fit. 

I’d bring plenty of ammo, if I were you. Doubt they’ll want to leave willingly. 

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Been getting word that CFP security have been getting a little more aggressive and started pushing people out of the homes they've built out of the scrap in the system and they want payback, so they came to us.

Head out to [Location|Address] and clear out the CFP there. Should be pretty cut and dry with a nice payday.

missions.name: Sweep and clear some CFP haunts
missions.overview:
Got word from my Judge that we're to take back some of the outposts that CFP have taken over. They're a little pissed that CFP's getting as much of a foothold in the system as they are and think it's making the Headhunters look weak.

Found a couple candidates near [LOCATION] that could use a sweep. Icing on the cake is that the head of security there is [TARGET]. Not sure if you've heard of 'em, but they shot up a handful of Clips last month, so it's a win-win. Get some territory back and punch out someone who could really stand to get got.

Stows out.

missions.description_lore:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.name: Tactical Strike
missions.overview:
Some folks don’t seem happy with us. Got word that several sub-capital ships and a number of escorts are targeting our ops. Figured the best way to keep ‘em from causing us trouble is to hit them before they hit us. 

We got eyes on a <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> that’s part of this squad, and it looks like they regularly pass by <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>, a spot tailor made for a surprise attack. A nearby emission cloud can hide you and anyone you bring along for muscle.

No sugarcoating it. This ain’t gonna be easy. But the payoff should make it worth your while. Finish the job and the main contractor gets a bonus <EM4>12 Council Scrip</EM4>. 

Plus, who knows what kinda good stuff you’ll find floating in all that wreckage.

Stows out.

Area of Operation: Nyx System 
Hostile Forces: Shattered Blade

Respectfully,   

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.name: Too Smart For Our Own Good
missions.overview:
We were a little too smart with this one and it’s kinda backfired. Sometimes you gotta dream big, you know? Anyway. we were looking to move some encrypted data to one of our data havens and decided to hide it in a ship’s blackbox. They filled the ship with “valuable” stuff as a decoy in case it got attacked. The plan worked a little too well and the cargo might have attracted the wrong kind of attention. They stole all the cargo but missed the blackbox. Bad news is the ship is now swarming with outlaws.

The data on that blackbox is useless to them, but we need it. If you can get it back for us, we can give you a nice cut from what we make. Seems like a fair deal, right?

Head to <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and after you’ve done your thing take the flight recorder to <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

-Bit Zeros

My hands are tied up here though, so I could use someone to help oversee the whole production line for me. Couldn't think of anyone better and more available than you.

1. PROCESSING - Take the raw material from  [Pickup1|Address] to [Pickup2|Address]
2. PACKAGING - Take the refined product from  [Pickup2|Address] to [Pickup3|Address]
3. DISTRIBUTION - Take the finished goods from  [Pickup3|Address] to [DropOff1|Address]

Just don't get distracted in the middle and wander off. It happens more often than you'd think. Manage to finish the full list, and I'll see to it you get nice cut of the profits.

-Wallace

missions.overview:
Got a plan to take care of a rat I've been dealing with and need a hand.

Had a client default on some debts and now they've decided they ain't going to pay up. Got a tip that they're hiding out over at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. If you can take out their fuel tanks they'll have no choice but to reconsider their crap decisions.

Just be sure you don't underestimate this slimebag. They might be dumb but they're not stupid, if you get me. I've heard this place is swarming with ships and turrets, you'd have to be a total nullbrain not to bring backup.

-Stows out

missions.description_lore:
Normally, I like to cook everything from scratch myself. Pride in product and all. But every once in a while, whether it's too much demand or too much heat or whatever, I need to rely on other labs for an order. 

My hands are tied up here though, so I could use someone to help oversee the whole production line for me. Couldn't think of anyone better and more available than you.

* TO-DO LIST *

1. PROCESSING - Take the raw material from  [Pickup1|Address] to [Pickup2|Address]
2. PACKAGING - Take the refined product from  [Pickup2|Address] to [Pickup3|Address]
3. DISTRIBUTION - Take the finished goods from  [Pickup3|Address] to [DropOff1|Address]

Just don't get distracted in the middle and wander off. It happens more often than you'd think. Manage to finish the full list, and I'll see to it you get nice cut of the profits.

-Wallace

You'll get paid when it's done.

missions.description_lore:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.name: Pyro RegionD MRT Criminals KillShip
missions.overview:
Another gang tried to make a move and carve out some territory for themselves. They failed but Headhunters don't forget. We've taken out most of them but one of the last members named [TARGET] has been spotted flying around [LOCATION].

Odds are they're getting desperate, so don't underestimate them in the fight.

You'll get paid when it's done.

Stows out.

tactical_analysis.content: Quantum Offset: Salta a un OM cercano al objetivo primero. Inicia el combate a < 2km.
Desync Warning: En 4.7, las Valkyries enemigas teletransportan. No uses misiles a menos de 3km.
Ballistics Meta: Los AD5B siguen siendo intocables por su capacidad de penetración de escudos.

missions.description_lore:
It is with deep disappointment that I send this message. A peerless contractor of ours was out on a job, but it seems like the target may have gotten the better of them.

I need you to travel to <EM4>Glaciem Ring Wreck Site</EM4> and see if our contractor, <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4>, is truly gone.

I suspect that the location will be somewhat chaotic since there will most likely still be multiple threats on site. Therefore, a supporting crew is strongly advised.

Sincerely,

Vaughn

missions.name: Tricky Ambush
missions.overview:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Looking for a competent contractor who can recruit a wingman to help execute an ambush. The target is a <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> which has been involved in several operations against one of our most important clients. By neutralizing it once and for all, it’ll make our client’s life a hell of a lot easier. While the [TARGET] is our focus, they usually don’t fly anywhere without a sizable escort, including large craft. 

We’ve gotten word that this group will be passing by <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> soon. Any chance you could hurry and beat them there? That spot has an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> that you can power down your ship and hide in. Then when they pass, you should have the upper hand.  

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The client knows this one will be tough, so they threw in a bonus payment of <EM4>8 MG Scrip</EM4> that’ll go to the main contractor.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.name: Turf War
missions.overview:
One of our Judges caught wind of XenoThreat trying to move in on our territory. Seems like they’re trying to take over [LOCATION]. We don’t want to let those psychos get any more of a foothold in system than they already have, so we’re putting some creds on the line to get ‘em to back off.

We want you to come down on them hard. Don’t let up till the whole place is a graveyard. We’ll send your payment once the bodies are ready to bury.

- Stows out.

missions.name: Turn Things to Favor
missions.overview:
Maybe Wikelo not have something you want made (that strange, but okay). Old souli would give out <EM4>favors</EM4>, very good way to prove that you do work for me. Collect enough and trade when I have something you want.

Bring things to <EM4>[DESTINATIONS]</EM4> and will trade for favor.

Bye.

Sinergia Shubin: Sube a Rep 2 para desbloquear el Láser de Minería Masivo.
Equipa un traje térmico industrial. Las estaciones Breaker en Nyx tienen fugas de refrigerante.

missions.description_lore:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [RewardValue_Wanted1] UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!



* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

missions.name: Tutorial: ArcCorp (Part 3/3)
missions.overview:
You’re almost through with the tutorial. All that remains is to take flight!

With your business in [LOCATION] finished, it’s time to leave the city – and eventually the planet. Make your way to the [TRANSITNAMESHORT] transit shuttles. These shuttles can take you all around [LOCATION] – but your destination is the spaceport, where an Anvil C8 Pisces has been temporarily provided for you.

This snub scouting ship is a great starter vessel, perfect for new pilots looking to get their wings.

tactical_analysis.content: Quantum Nav Mode: Mantén escudos al 100% mientras cargas el motor para saltos rápidos.
Atmospheric Efficiency: Sube a 10km en ángulo de 45° antes de saltar en planetas con atmósfera.

missions.overview:
Well done!

With the first part behind you, you should now have some basic familiarity with the movement controls, managing your hunger and thirst, and some of the core functionality of your mobiGlas – namely the Contract Manager and your Journal.

This next section will help you familiarize yourself with [LOCATION] and take you to visit [STORENAME], a weapons store here in [LOCATION].

During the Alpha phase of Star Citizen’s development, we will be using a currency called aUEC (Alpha United Earth Credits). This is a temporary currency specifically designed for testing the in-game economy and balance.

missions.name: RoX SD
missions.overview:
A distress beacon came in from <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> about a ship under attack from XenoThreat. The pilot reports that their shields are failing and they can't outrun the attackers.

The ship's a <EM4>[SHIP]</EM4>, but the pilot's Human, which  according to XenoThreat's twisted way of thinking, makes them a traitor to Humanity and a target for their hate.

We're looking for operators to head out there and do some good.

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.name: Refueling Multi Nyx Hard
missions.overview:
Hey again,

I've got a beacon at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> and this one's a big one. An entire little fleet of ships all burned out of fuel at the same time. Impressive coordination and lack of planning at the same time. 

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FUELRATE] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>[QTFUELRATE] aUEC per SCU of Quantum </EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

Payment hinges on you delivering those supplies to [Dropoff1|Address]. Anyone you kill will just be a perk.     

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.description_lore:
I've been conscripted to provide a trigger pull for a very motivated client. The target is <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4>, a loathsome character by all accounts who's seemed to relish the temporary authority that their mercenary position affords them. They believe their sadism to be righteous and my client would like to remind them otherwise.

They have recently been hired by ASD as part of a mercenary team at <EM4>[Location]</EM4>, so it won't be an easy approach as there will undoubtedly be other armed individuals. I'll expect you to react accordingly, but [TargetName|Last] is your target.

You will be paid upon completion.

All the best,

Vaughn

missions.description_lore:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [RewardValue_Wanted1] UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!



* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

missions.description_lore:

* TO-DO LIST *

1. PROCESSING - Take the raw material from  [Pickup1|Address] to [Pickup2|Address]
2. PACKAGING - Take the refined product from  [Pickup2|Address] to [Pickup3|Address]
3. DISTRIBUTION - Take the finished goods from  [Pickup3|Address] to [DropOff1|Address]

Just don't get distracted in the middle and wander off. It happens more often than you'd think. Manage to finish the full list, and I'll see to it you get nice cut of the profits.

-Wallace

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit

missions.name: URGENT: Boarding Action In Progress
missions.overview:
An executive client just informed us that their 890 Jump had been intercepted at [LOCATION] and boarded by outlaws. They would prefer to have this handled privately owing to the sensitive nature of proprietary data that's being stored aboard. 

Your first priority will be to clear all outlaws as quickly as possible so that a recovery team can be dispatched to return the ship to the owner. The longer the outlaws have control of the vessel, the higher the chance it will be lost. I recommend you acquire a team for this outing to expedite matters. 

Note that thanks to a small contingent of Security Personnel who stayed aboard, all surviving members of the crew were able to flee in an escape craft. The current status of the remaining security is unknown, but just in case, keep an eye out for friendlies when you engage the hostiles.

Secondly, if at all possible, the client is *very* interested in preventing the theft of the aforementioned data. If you are able to stop the theft of their confidential data stores before they are transmitted, a generous bonus will be issued.

Needless to say, this is a client I would very much like to keep happy. 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

missions.description_lore:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.name: Ship Refueling Intro Nyx
missions.overview:
Hey!

DD from the United Wayfarers Club here.

The UWC offers repair, rearming and refuelling services across the UEE. It just so happens that we're on the look-out for new affiliates whose ships are fitted for refuelling. If you've got the fuel pods and like it when people are pleased to see you, the UWC might be the club for you.

And if you think it might be, I've got a live beacon you might like.

If you do happen to like it, a word to the wise: <EM4>make sure your fuel pods are full before you head out</EM4>.

A Club member has run out of fuel at <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. I'm not sure on the details, like how they ended up out there with no Go Juice, but the UWC doesn't like to leave folk hanging.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FUELRATE] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>[QTFUELRATE] aUEC per SCU of Quantum </EM4>. As a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

It's a straightforward run. Perfect if you want to get a feel for this kind of job. Get out there, fill up the tanks of their <EM4>[SHIP]</EM4> and get them on their way. Do enough runs like this, and the process becomes muscle memory. Until then, there's a <EM4>journal entry</EM4> on your mobiGlas called ""Refueling Protocols"" that covers the basics.

There have been no reports of outlaw activity in that sector, but stay alert. I always recommend you aim for a fast turnaround. The sooner you're done, the sooner I can fix you up with another contract. UWC's always looking for new affiliates. 

Looking forward to working with you.

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

MISSION SPECS

Hostile Forces: Unknown
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship, Personal Arms

Deacon Tobin

missions.description_lore:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [RewardValue_Wanted1] UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!



* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

missions.description_lore:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

missions.name: Vital Resources Needed For Research
missions.overview:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of three resources essential for their experiments: <EM4>saldynium, jaclium, and carinite</EM4>.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

Though we haven’t been able to do thorough scans, there’s a strong belief among our teams that Hathor’s defunct Orbital Laser Platforms were built above areas with a high concentration of these resources. Reactivating these OLP could be your best hope of acquiring what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.

You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.

They’ve been spotted around [LOCATION], so get there and take care of it.

Normally, I like to cook everything from scratch myself. Pride in product and all. But every once in a while, whether it's too much demand or too much heat or whatever, I need to rely on other labs for an order. 

My hands are tied up here though, so I could use someone to help oversee the whole production line for me. Couldn't think of anyone better and more available than you.

* TO-DO LIST *

1. PROCESSING - Take the raw material from  [Pickup1|Address] to [Pickup2|Address]

If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.name: XenoThreat = GoodLoot
missions.overview:
You know who probably deserves taking down a peg or two? XenoThreat. 

We pulled some intel off a server that had details of all their upcoming operations, and for the right price, we could send you the exact coordinates of where an XT ship fully loaded with primo cargo is waiting. 

Here’s a little taste of what info we have so you know we’re not messing around. XenoThreat stashed the ship in a locked asteroid base hangar that can only be accessed via the station’s elevators. We can’t get the hangar doors open for you but have adjusted the security protocols so you’ll be able to use a console in the hangar to override the lockdown.  

Interested?

missions.description_lore:
ABOUT THE JOB
While your past performance has not been to our standards, microTech Protection Services has decided to offer you a chance to redeem yourself. 

To reevaluate your skills, we would like you to apprehend [TargetName] from [Location|Address].

While there will be other criminals at the site, your main focus should be on completing the bounty.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [Location|Address].
• Neutralize [TargetName]; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Bounty Hunters Guild membership and appropriate certification.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

missions.name: XL Purchase Order: Hand Mined Materials
missions.overview:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>[SYSTEM] </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for rare materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

There are only a few known locations where these materials can be sourced, mainly from now defunct Hathor Group sites on <EM4>Daymar and Aberdeen</EM4>. Our suggestion would be to head to the Platform Alignment Facilities (PAF) and attempt to reactivate their Orbital Laser Platform (OLP) to access the materials below the planet's surface.

Reminder, since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[MULTITOOL]</EM4>.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

tactical_analysis.content: Operation Breaker (Nyx): Usa el monorraíl para llegar al Warehouse inmediatamente.
Sinergia Shubin: Sube a Rep 2 para desbloquear el Láser de Minería Masivo.
Equipa un traje térmico industrial. Las estaciones Breaker en Nyx tienen fugas de refrigerante.

missions.description_lore:
I've been conscripted to provide a trigger pull for a very motivated client. The target is <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4>, a loathsome character by all accounts who's seemed to relish the temporary authority that their mercenary position affords them. They believe their sadism to be righteous and my client would like to remind them otherwise.

They have recently been hired by ASD as part of a mercenary team at <EM4>[Location]</EM4>, so it won't be an easy approach as there will undoubtedly be other armed individuals. I'll expect you to react accordingly, but [TargetName|Last] is your target.

You will be paid upon completion.

All the best,

Vaughn

missions.description_lore:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.name: Yellow Level Contract: Ambush An Amateur
missions.overview:
Care to help us ghost a bad guy? 

We’ve been hired to hunt down an outlaw flying a <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>. Shouldn’t be too hard since they take the same flightpath each day. That makes them a prime target for an ambush if I ever saw one. I’ve analyzed the route and determined that <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> is the ideal spot to strike. There’s an emission cloud there that’ll be perfect to hide your ship’s signature while you wait.   

Job is simple if you’re interested. Head to the location, hide out, power down, and then wait for them to fly by. Sometimes they roll alone but they often have other single-seat ships with them. Shouldn’t be too hard to handle for a pro. Plus, we’ll still have reinforcements nearby and ready to deploy once it pops off.

Pull this off and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of <EM4>1 MG Scrip</EM4>.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

tactical_analysis.content: Quantum Offset: Salta a un OM cercano al objetivo primero. Inicia el combate a < 2km.
Desync Warning: En 4.7, las Valkyries enemigas teletransportan. No uses misiles a menos de 3km.
Ballistics Meta: Los AD5B siguen siendo intocables por su capacidad de penetración de escudos.

missions.description_lore: You like adventure, right? This armor good for it. Let you go dangerous places, but not too heavy. Stay light. Wikelo found these and will trade if you want. You win, Wikelo win. Bye.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

Clinical Research Outsourcing

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

missions.name: Foxwell DefendDestructibleEntities Pyro VeryEasy
missions.overview:
Calling all pilots – one of our clients is looking for some protection for their <EM4>[OBJECTS]</EM4>, based in <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>. From what we’ve gathered, the attackers are a group of wannabe outlaw pests who probably haven’t realized the value of the assets they’re trying to destroy, just wreaking havoc for the sake of it. Still, the client’s property is important, so should be kept as intact as possible.

If you take care of them to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering <EM4>2 MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor. 

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

missions.description_lore:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.description_lore:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.

This introductory contract will require you to head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.

Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>Levski</EM4>.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

missions.description_lore:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.

NO MORE.

Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.

In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of [RewardValue_Wanted1] UEC per outlaw dealt with. 

Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!



* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

Thanks to a simple design with reinforced stitching, the glove can survive a rough night on the streets and still be ready for elegant evening out.

resources.name: Salvage AvengerTitan
resources.description_lore: The 250-E is an intuitive aiming aid that produces a laser visible to you and others. NV-TAC built the attachment to be lightweight yet durable so it won't add extra weight to your weapon.

ships.name: Avenger Stalker
ships.description_lore: Initially designed as a frontline carrier for the military, the Avenger Stalker took a different path, ultimately having a long and storied career as the standard patrol craft of the UEE Advocacy. Utilizing its cargo hold for prisoner transport, the Avenger features a sturdy, reliable hull and the capacity for larger-than-expected engine mounts. *This is the standard Avenger chassis with the Stalker Prisoner Transport module pre-installed.*

ships.name: Avenger Titan
ships.description_lore: With extra room in the back, the Titan’s hold is free to carry cargo. Couple that with the Avenger’s tried and true combat abilities and you’ve got a light cargo hauler that’s more than capable of handling itself in a fight.

ships.name: Avenger Titan Renegade
ships.description_lore: Created as part of the ‘Masters of Flight’ series in conjunction with the flight-sim Arena Commander, the Renegade pays tribute to famed pilot Danny Solomon for his notable work with the Advocacy to bring justice to Bremen. This Avenger Titan comes equipped with a specialized dogfighting-focused loadout and a special-edition livery honoring this iconic ship.

ships.name: Avenger Warlock
ships.description_lore:
Outfitted with a Behring REP-8 EMP Generator, the Warlock makes non-lethal suppression possible via a powerful electromagnetic wave capable of disabling any electronics within the blast radius.

*This is the standard Avenger chassis with the Warlock EMP module pre-installed.*

ships.name: Eclipse
ships.description_lore: The Aegis Eclipse is a bomber designed to get in and strike before it's even spotted. After extensive service with the UEE, this high-tech military stalwart is making its debut on the civilian market for 2947.

ships.name: Eclipse
ships.description_lore: The Aegis Eclipse is a bomber designed to get in and strike before it's even spotted. After extensive service with the UEE, this high-tech military stalwart is making its debut on the civilian market for 2947.

ships.name: Gladius
ships.description_lore: The Gladius is an older design which has been updated over the years to keep up with modern technology. In military circles, the Gladius is beloved for its performance and its simplicity. A fast, light fighter with a laser-focus on dogfighting, the Gladius is an ideal interceptor or escort ship.

ships.name: Gladius Valiant
ships.description_lore: Created as part of the ‘Masters of Flight’ series in conjunction with the flight-sim Arena Commander, the Valiant pays tribute to famed defense pilot Condi Hillard for being the first Human on record to defeat a Vanduul in combat. This Gladius comes equipped with a specialized dogfighting focused loadout and a custom special edition livery honoring her iconic ship.

ships.name: Hammerhead
ships.description_lore: A fast patrol ship with multiple turrets designed to combat fighters, the Hammerhead is equally suited to support larger capital ships in a fleet or act as a flagship for fighter groups.

ships.name: Hammerhead
ships.description_lore: A fast patrol ship with multiple turrets designed to combat fighters, the Hammerhead is equally suited to support larger capital ships in a fleet or act as a flagship for fighter groups.

ships.name: Hammerhead 2949 Best In Show Edition
ships.description_lore: A fast patrol ship with multiple turrets designed to combat fighters, the Hammerhead is equally suited to support larger capital ships in a fleet or act as a flagship for fighter groups.

ships.name: Idris-M
ships.description_lore: Larger than a bomber but smaller than a ship of the line, frigates occupy an interesting space in the pantheon of warships. While they lack the heavy armor and the capital weaponry of a cruiser, frigates are more maneuverable and are highly configurable.

ships.name: Idris-P
ships.description_lore: The Aegis Idris has long served the UEE Navy as its go-to frigate, striking fear into every soul unfortunate enough to meet it. Fly the civilianized Idris-P to experience the full might of Humanity’s most devastating capital-class gunship.

ships.name: Idris-P
ships.description_lore: The Aegis Idris has long served the UEE Navy as its go-to frigate, striking fear into every soul unfortunate enough to meet it. Fly the civilianized Idris-P to experience the full might of Humanity’s most devastating capital-class gunship.

ships.name: Idris-P
ships.description_lore: The Aegis Idris has long served the UEE Navy as its go-to frigate, striking fear into every soul unfortunate enough to meet it. Fly the civilianized Idris-P to experience the full might of Humanity’s most devastating capital-class gunship.

ships.name: Javelin
ships.description_lore: Designed for use by the UEE military, the Javelin is a massive, modular capital ship that can be appropriated for entrepreneurial use. With a detailed interior, plenty of modular room options and a high crew capacity, the Javelin is a ship that has made a name for itself in a variety of roles.

ships.name: Reclaimer
ships.description_lore:
The Aegis Reclaimer is an industrial salvage ship. Equipped with a reinforced cargo bay, a long-range jump drive and launch pods for unmanned drones, the Reclaimer is an ideal ship for taking advantage of deep space wrecks. Tractor beams, floodlights, scanner options and docking ports round out the tools on this capable, utilitarian spacecraft.

The listed Cargo Capacity is only for the dedicated Cargo Room and does not account for the salvaged material capacity which will be detailed later.

ships.name: Reclaimer 2949 Best In Show Edition
ships.description_lore:
The Aegis Reclaimer is an industrial salvage ship. Equipped with a reinforced cargo bay, a long-range jump drive and launch pods for unmanned drones, the Reclaimer is an ideal ship for taking advantage of deep space wrecks. Tractor beams, floodlights, scanner options and docking ports round out the tools on this capable, utilitarian spacecraft.

The listed Cargo Capacity is only for the dedicated Cargo Room and does not account for the salvaged material capacity which will be detailed later.

ships.name: Redeemer
ships.description_lore: Designed by Star Citizen's backers, the Aegis Redeemer is a powerful fighting ship capable of holding its own in combat with a powerful weapons payload. Dotted with turrets and missiles, the Redeemer also doubles as an armored landing craft capable of delivering armored soldiers for first person combat!

ships.name: Retaliator
ships.description_lore: The Aegis Dynamics’ Retaliator has landed! One of the United Empire of Earth’s most powerful warbirds, the Retaliator was designed as a fearsome weapons platform designed to strike and kill capital ships. A key portion of the UEE’s power projection, Retaliator squadrons have served with distinction against outlaws, the Vanduul and elsewhere. This version of the Retaliator includes the bomb bay and torpedo launcher.

ships.name: Sabre
ships.description_lore: Part of Aegis Dynamics’ Phase Two of new ship models, the Sabre was designed as a space superiority fighter for those situations where you need to leave a lighter footprint. Designed to be a rapid responder, the Sabre is more than capable of establishing battlefield dominance for any number of combat scenarios.

ships.name: Sabre Comet
ships.description_lore: Created as part of the ‘Masters of Flight’ series in conjunction with the flight-sim Arena Commander, the Comet pays tribute to famed pilot Captain Kamur Dalion for his work with Aegis to usher in a new era of combat ship design. This Sabre comes equipped with a specialized dogfighting focused loadout and a custom special edition livery honoring this iconic ship.

ships.name: Sabre Firebird
ships.description_lore: A high-speed fighter specializing in rapid barrages from its bespoke missile array. Built to destroy threats before they can react, it’s equally at home heading out on long-range missions or scrambling to protect your base of operations.

ships.name: Sabre Peregrine
ships.description_lore: The fastest Sabre model yet conceived, the Peregrine takes the infamous military-born chassis and tunes it for pure unadulterated speed.

ships.name: Sabre Raven
ships.description_lore: Part of Aegis Dynamics’ Phase Two of new ship models, the Sabre was designed as a space superiority fighter for those situations where you need to leave a lighter footprint. They have raised the bar yet again with their Raven variant, maintaining all the speed and maneuverability of its Sabre forebear, but with a lower ship signature, making it a fast, stealthy infiltrator.

ships.name: Tiburon
ships.description_lore: A ferocious and forward-facing force capable of eliminating the deadliest prey out there. Assemble a crew of military-minded recruits to discharge every weapon, gun, and missile the Tiburon has at its command as you circle your prey.

ships.name: Vanguard Harbinger
ships.description_lore: The Vanguard Harbinger is Earth’s standard fighter-bomber, converting the standard Warden model’s escape pod into a potent bomb bay. The extended range of the Vanguard and the relatively small profile mean that it can go where carrier-based planes or larger strategic bombers don’t… and then strike hard and make it back to frontier bases. The Vanguard Harbinger is a powerful bomber that can operate out of the roughest forward operating bases.

ships.name: Vanguard Hoplite
ships.description_lore: The Vanguard Hoplite is a cross between the winning Vanguard deep space fighter and a dedicated boarding ship. Adapted from proven assault ship designs, the Hoplite is the perfect tool for inserting an armored strike team with enough firepower to get them out again.

ships.name: Vanguard Sentinel
ships.description_lore: The Vanguard Sentinel is a ship that’s designed to fight smart instead of taking enemies head on. The conversion features an AR cockpit, an external e-War pod, decoy missiles and a set of EMP charges. Vanguard Sentinels often provide necessary combat support for combined operations. A lone Sentinel assigned wild weasel tasks is frequently paired with Harbinger bombers and Warden escorts for large attack missions.

ships.name: Vanguard Warden
ships.description_lore: The A3G Vanguard Warden is one of Aegis Dynamics' most versatile and deadly long-range fighters. With an extra heavy frame, and an extra nasty loadout, the Warden is an absolute beast on the frontlines of any assault operation.

ships.name: Arrow
ships.description_lore: Meet Anvil's ‘light fighter of the future’. Featuring an ultra-aerodynamic frame, slight profile, and the most advanced manoeuvring thruster tech available, it’s the most agile ship in its class. It can also hold its own in a knock-down-drag-out thanks to a generous standard weapons package that includes quad missile racks and a full complement of countermeasures. The Arrow is designed specifically to leave would-be interlopers thoroughly bewildered. After all, how can they kill what they can't catch?

ships.name: Asgard
ships.description_lore: A heavily armored vehicle-dropship equipped for boundless resilience in the hottest combat zones. Power through relentless fire to deliver vital reinforcements, hold the front line, and keep the enemy retreating.

ships.name: C8 Pisces
ships.description_lore: Additional firepower turns the base Pisces into a highly capable mini-explorer. Ideal for inter-system travel or investigating tight spots inaccessible to larger ships, it’s a small ship ready for big adventures.

ships.name: C8R Pisces Rescue
ships.description_lore: With the addition of an onboard Tier 3 Medical Bed, the C8R Pisces can treat minor injuries and keep a patient stable while transporting them to the safety of a larger ship, station, or nearby medical facility, making it an invaluable asset for short-range search and rescue.

ships.name: C8X Pisces Expedition
ships.description_lore: Additional firepower turns the base Pisces into a highly capable mini-explorer. Ideal for inter-system travel or investigating tight spots inaccessible to larger ships, it’s a small ship ready for big adventures.

ships.name: Carrack
ships.description_lore: The Anvil Carrack features reinforced fuel tanks for long-duration flight, an advanced jump drive, and a dedicated computer core for jump charting operations. Originally a military exclusive, the Carrack is now available for civilian use. On-board accommodations include crew medical and repair facilities, and a mapping-oriented sensor suite.

ships.name: Carrack
ships.description_lore: The Anvil Carrack features reinforced fuel tanks for long-duration flight, an advanced jump drive, and a dedicated computer core for jump charting operations. Originally a military exclusive, the Carrack is now available for civilian use. On-board accommodations include crew medical and repair facilities, and a mapping-oriented sensor suite.

ships.name: Carrack Expedition
ships.description_lore: The Anvil Carrack features reinforced fuel tanks for long-duration flight, an advanced jump drive, and a dedicated computer core for jump charting operations. Originally a military exclusive, the Carrack is now available for civilian use. On-board accommodations include crew medical and repair facilities, and a mapping-oriented sensor suite.

ships.name: Centurion
ships.description_lore: Built on Anvil’s popular Atlas Platform, the Centurion presents a tactical solution for short-range anti-aircraft operations. Dominate any combat zone by assuring immediate threats from above are dealt with quickly and efficiently, thanks to the Centurion’s custom energy-based AA turret.

ships.name: F7A Hornet Mk I
ships.description_lore: A space combat legend of centuries past.

ships.name: F7A Hornet Mk II
ships.description_lore: The UEE Navy's premier carrier-based fighter craft, the F7A is the front-line attack ship for military combat missions. While not outfitted for long range runs, the Hornet can take her share of hits... and dish out a consistent, powerful response.

ships.name: F7C Hornet Mk I
ships.description_lore: To the enemy, it is a weapon never to be underestimated. To allies, it's a savior. The F7C Hornet is the same dependable and resilient multi-purpose fighter that has become the face of the UEE Navy. The F7C is the foundation to build on and meet whatever requirements you have in mind.

ships.name: F7C Hornet Mk II
ships.description_lore: Tame the power, speed, and offensive punch of the UEE Navy’s premier carrier-based fighter, made famous by its dominating role in the Vanduul war. Sporting a pair of daunting Size 4 Gatlings and a custom missile rack capable of delivering a devastating payload, it's easy to see why this heavy-hitting fighter is a legend and mainstay of Naval operations.

ships.name: F7C Hornet Wildfire Mk I
ships.description_lore: Created as part of the ‘Masters of Flight’ series in conjunction with the flight-sim Arena Commander, the Wildfire pays tribute to famed pilot Aria Reilly for her distinguished service with the legendary Squadron 42. This Hornet comes equipped with her own personally selected loadout preferences and a custom special edition livery honoring her iconic ship.

ships.name: F7C-M Hornet Heartseeker Mk I
ships.description_lore: Designed for pilots whose true love is the pulse-pounding thrill of a harrowing dogfight, Anvil's limited-edition Heartseeker is 'the one' for true combat die-hards. Loaded with top-of-the-line near military-spec components and four imposing Behring laser cannons, this fierce eradicator hones the legendary combat proficiency of the Super Hornet to give you the ultimate edge in space combat.

ships.name: F7C-M Hornet Heartseeker Mk II
ships.description_lore: Designed for pilots whose true love is the pulse-pounding thrill of a harrowing dogfight, Anvil's limited-edition Heartseeker is 'the one' for true combat die-hards. Loaded with top-of-the-line near military-spec components and four imposing Behring laser cannons, this fierce eradicator hones the legendary combat proficiency of the Super Hornet to give you the ultimate edge in space combat.

ships.name: F7C-M Super Hornet Mk I
ships.description_lore: The closest to the Military load-out as is legally possible for a Civilian model, the F7C-M Super Hornet reattaches the ball turret and offers near milspec parts under the hood. Proving that two heads are better than one, a second seat has been added to split the logistic and combat duty, making the Super Hornet a truly terrifying mark to engage.

ships.name: F7C-M Super Hornet Mk II
ships.description_lore: The Super Hornet is back and upgraded to Mk II spec, making it deadlier than ever. The only Hornet model with two seats, it features a dedicated gunner’s turret for increased firepower, accuracy, and all-round combat proficiency.

ships.name: F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk I
ships.description_lore: If the Ghost is made to hide, the Tracker is made to seek. The F7C-R Tracker boasts an advanced radar suite making it ideal for deep-space explorers who require depth and accuracy in their scan packages. Local militia and larger merc units will also repurpose Trackers to act as mobile C&C ships for their squadrons.

ships.name: F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk II
ships.description_lore: Formidable fighter with enhanced scanning capabilities.

ships.name: F7C-S Hornet Ghost Mk I
ships.description_lore: Through a combination of low-emission drives, low-draw weapons, and Void Armor technology capable of diffusing scans, the F7C-S Ghost is built for the pilot who wants to keep a low profile. The Ghost is capable of slipping past the most ardent of observers to accomplish whatever goal you need to accomplish. Don't worry, we won't ask.

ships.name: F7C-S Hornet Ghost Mk II
ships.description_lore: Low-signature fighter built for scouting and ambushing unaware foes.

ships.name: F8A Lightning
ships.description_lore: Few vehicles inspire the same awe as the legendary F8 Lightning. A force to be reckoned with, it has protected Humanity countless times from countless threats at home and far from civilization.

ships.name: F8C Lightning
ships.description_lore: Few vehicles inspire the same awe as the legendary F8 Lightning. A force to be reckoned with, it has protected Humanity countless times from countless threats at home and far from civilization.

ships.name: F8C Lightning
ships.description_lore: Few vehicles inspire the same awe as the legendary F8 Lightning. A force to be reckoned with, it has protected Humanity countless times from countless threats at home and far from civilization.

ships.name: F8C Lightning Executive Edition
ships.description_lore: Few vehicles inspire the same awe as the legendary F8 Lightning. A force to be reckoned with, it has protected Humanity countless times from countless threats at home and far from civilization.

ships.name: Gladiator
ships.description_lore: The civilian model of the Gladiator appeals to those that want to explore the ‘Verse with a bit of added security. Supporting a maximum of two, the Gladiator is perfectly equipped to explore and fight with or without a wingman. The Civilian model allows pilots to choose between an extra cargo hold or a bomb bay.

ships.name: Hawk
ships.description_lore: A small, light fighter with an emphasis on weaponry, the Hawk boasts an impressive arsenal of lethal and non-lethal weapons, making it a perfect ship for independent bounty hunters or local security looking for a little more punch.

ships.name: Hurricane
ships.description_lore: Big things do come in small packages: the Hurricane is a fighting spacecraft that packs a deadly punch into a slight fuselage. The spacecraft compensates for its lack of creature comforts with its powerful armament - six guns capable of blasting their way through nearly anything. Hurricane pilots have yet to find an enemy shield they can't knock down.

ships.name: Paladin
ships.description_lore: A formidable gunship with durable armor and immense firepower. Capable of hitting multiple targets simultaneously, the missiles, side turrets, and moveable central turret provide almost complete coverage as you lead the charge against enemies of the Empire.

ships.name: Spartan
ships.description_lore: Built on Anvil’s robust Atlas Platform, the same chassis used for their devastating Ballista air defense system, the Spartan takes armored personal transport to the next level. A fully armored hold outfitted with eight comfortable jump seats is the perfect way to get your squad onto any battlefield. The Spartan’s low profile keeps it safe from anti-aircraft weaponry, and a remote gatling turret helps clear the area for easier deployment.

ships.name: Terrapin
ships.description_lore: Outfitted with long-range scanners and encased in heavy armor and oversized shields, the U4A-3 Terrapin can face potentially hazardous circumstances with confidence, making it the ultimate combat scout and reconnaissance vehicle, at least according to Anvil.

ships.name: Terrapin Medic
ships.description_lore: Durable, heavily armored rescue ship that can take on any battlefield or environ.

ships.name: Valkyrie
ships.description_lore:
In the days of antiquity, the Valkyrie were believed to choose who would live and who would die on the field of war. Now, Anvil is putting that choice in your hands. Seize fate and turn the tide of battle.

Rugged, high-performance jump seats safely transport up to twenty personnel into and out of the fray. A vehicle bay and speed ramp efficiently launch ground-based transport or reconnaissance vehicles for unmatched support. Four powerful VTOL thrusters facilitate surgically precise take-offs and landings, while a devastating array of weaponry blurs the line between dropship and gunship.

ships.name: Valkyrie
ships.description_lore:
In the days of antiquity, the Valkyrie were believed to choose who would live and who would die on the field of war. Now, Anvil is putting that choice in your hands. Seize fate and turn the tide of battle.

Rugged, high-performance jump seats safely transport up to twenty personnel into and out of the fray. A vehicle bay and speed ramp efficiently launch ground-based transport or reconnaissance vehicles for unmatched support. Four powerful VTOL thrusters facilitate surgically precise take-offs and landings, while a devastating array of weaponry blurs the line between dropship and gunship.

ships.name: Khartu-al
ships.description_lore: The Xi'an Aopoa corporation manufactures an export model of the Qhire Khartu, the Khartu-al, for sale to Human civilians. The export model features the same Xi'an maneuvering rig, but control surfaces modified for Human use and a more limited armament.

ships.name: Nox
ships.description_lore: Hit the skids with the 2947 Nox. This speedy and maneuverable open-canopy racer from Aopoa is capable of zipping along planet surfaces or deep space. Available for the first time in Human space, the Nox has been specifically redesigned for Human pilots, so grab your ship and head to the racetrack today.

ships.name: Nox Kue
ships.description_lore: Deriving its name from the Xi’an word for ‘thrust,’ the Nox Kue delivers that and more. This limited version of the open-canopy racer features a stunning brushed-silver finish and was specifically created to celebrate the inaugural sale of the first Nox for Human riders.

ships.name: San'tok.yāi
ships.description_lore: Meet the next evolution of Xi'an tech and design innovation. The San’tok.yāi is a fighter that literally flies circles around the competition.

ships.name: ATLS
ships.description_lore: Single-handedly load and unload the biggest haulers with the power of Argo. The ATLS power suit’s unique exo-frame helps you work quickly, easily, and safely – whatever the task.

ships.name: ATLS GEO
ships.description_lore: Built on the proven ATLS power suit chassis, the GEO is outfitted with bespoke mining components and a Jump Pack to open up the most inaccessible (and prosperous) corners of the galaxy.

ships.name: CSV-SM
ships.description_lore: The CSV-SM is the logistical lifeblood of any hangar or outpost operation. Move essential materials freely and easily.

ships.name: MOLE
ships.description_lore: ARGO’s pragmatic no-nonsense approach to ship design is celebrated in the unmistakable silhouette of the MOLE. Just one look at this machine and you know it means business. Tap into your full potential with the combined force of ARGO’s patented trilateral mining system. The MOLE has a total of 24 mineral pods, each holding 12 SCU. Eight pods are usable at one time – when they’re full, either head home or jettison them for collection by another vessel and carry on mining. Three independently controlled articulated extraction stations allow for maximum power and near-limitless versatility. The MOLE lives by the adage ’many hands make for light work’.

ships.name: MOTH
ships.description_lore: A medium salvager built to bridge the gap between light salvage and full industrial undertakings. With Argo’s industrial heritage leading the design, the MOTH is the natural next step for those looking for team-driven, larger-scale operations.

ships.name: MPUV Cargo
ships.description_lore: The ARGO Astronautics MPUV-1C (commonly ‘Argo Cargo’) is a dedicated merchant transfer ship, a ubiquitous intergalactic stevedore. Vast numbers of Argo Cargos are responsible for loading and unloading goods onto massive long-haul transports and miners that cannot otherwise land on planets or drydocks, such as the Hull D and the Orion. Some captains choose to own and operate their own Argo, while others pay privately owned ships operating as port services a rental fee for performing the unloading process.

ships.name: MPUV Personnel
ships.description_lore: The ARGO Astronautics MPUV-1P (commonly ‘Argo Personnel.’) is geared towards a simple but incredibly important responsibility: moving groups of people from place to place. The UEE Navy uses MPUV-1Ps extensively, and any new recruit can likely recall those terrifying moments in which such a ship carried them to their first space assignment. In civilian hands, Argo Personnel ships are adapted for everything from standard taxi services to use as makeshift combat dropships. The ARGO is capable of carrying up to eight Humans and their equipment.

ships.name: MPUV Tractor
ships.description_lore: The MPUV Tractor features dual tractor beams for effortless cargo handling alongside the sturdy, reliable design you expect from Argo. Load and unload any size freighter with ease.

ships.name: RAFT
ships.description_lore: As it does with all its industrial concerns, Argo takes cargo transport very seriously, on every scale. The RAFT is no exception, able to carry a total hauling capacity of 192 SCU. Perfect for entry-level haulers and old pros alike, the RAFT is an ideal solution for reliable local freight transport. Once again, Argo gets the job done.

ships.name: SRV
ships.description_lore: Leave no one behind. The SRV is a specialized recovery ship built for the extremes. From search-and-rescue to moving cargo containers, its innovative tractor-beam system makes towing effortless, while enhanced shields and heavy armor ensure pilot safety in tough situations.ILW 2024 Day 1-2

ships.name: ATLS Cool Metal Color
ships.description_lore: Single-handedly load and unload the biggest haulers with the power of Argo. The ATLS power suit’s unique exo-frame helps you work quickly, easily, and safely – whatever the task.

ships.name: ATLS Snowland Color
ships.description_lore: Single-handedly load and unload the biggest haulers with the power of Argo. The ATLS power suit’s unique exo-frame helps you work quickly, easily, and safely – whatever the task.

ships.name: Defender
ships.description_lore: Meet the Banu Defender, a multi-crew fighter whose patchwork design highlights technology from a variety of species. Featuring modest accommodations for its crew and easy access to components, the Defender gets its name from the role it serves: the first line of defense against enemy attacks. That's why the Defender makes the ideal companion to the Merchantman: one to do the heavy hauling and the other to perform the deadly dogfighting.

ships.name: HoverQuad
ships.description_lore: You know that place where the roads end, and sky runs out? That little place at the very edge of adventure, where there’s nowhere to go but forward? Where over every dune, and around every patch of weird flora, you might tumble headlong into glorious unfamiliarity?  That’s HoverQuad country, and it’s begging to be explored.

ships.name: Mustang Alpha
ships.description_lore: Inspired by Consolidated Outland CEO Silas Koerner’s cutting edge vision, the Mustang Alpha is a sleek, stylish spacecraft that uses ultralight alloys to push power ratios to the limits, albeit sometimes unsafely. And now, with the optional Cargo Carrier, you can have the Alpha’s advantages without sacrificing carrying capacity.

ships.name: Mustang Beta
ships.description_lore: The Mustang Beta, with its unprecedented range, is made for long duration flights. The factory standard Tarsus Leaper Jump Engine enables the Beta to travel to the galaxy’s farthest systems with ease, while the ship’s unique Com4T living quarters will make the journey feel like you never left home.

ships.name: Mustang CitizenCon 2948 Edition
ships.description_lore: Make the ultimate statement and show the universe that you are a paragon of style and a bulwark of freedom. With this limited Vindicator Edition livery, the maverick designers at Consolidated Outland have pulled out all the stops, creating a trim package that commemorates CitizenCon 2948 and embodies the spirit of daring that defines both the original vision of Silas Koerner and the unyielding determination of the UEE.

ships.name: Mustang Delta
ships.description_lore: While it may not be able to go toe to toe with some of the military specific ships, by reinforcing the Mustang’s already strong hull construction with Consolidated Outland’s own line of Cavalry Class Mass Reduction Armor, the Delta has a reduced cross-sectional signature that evens the playing field.

ships.name: Mustang Gamma
ships.description_lore: Consolidated Outland’s design and engineering teams have managed to tweak and refine the Mustang into an admirable racer. The end result, the Mustang Gamma, has smooth acceleration, and power on demand thanks to an innovative package featuring three powerful Magma Jet engines for maximum thrust.

ships.name: Mustang Omega
ships.description_lore: Consolidated Outland teamed up with custom tuning company Accelerated Mass Design to create a limited edition racer that features a ramped up fuel intake for faster recycling of the ship’s already impressive boost system. To cap off the collaboration, AMD enlisted resident underground artist Sektor8 to design the dynamic paint job.

ships.name: Nomad
ships.description_lore:
Imagine the versatility of a medium-sized, multi-purpose freighter packed into a compact frame. Imagine a ship designed for lone pilots finding their way across a galaxy teeming with possibilities.

The Nomad is ready to go anywhere and do anything - the perfect solution for anyone yearning to start a brand-new adventure.

ships.name: A1 Spirit
ships.description_lore: Crusader Industries brings its usual commitment to excellence directly to the civilian market with the A1 Spirit, a mid-size multi-purpose starship equipped as a light bomber but packing enough versatility to tackle multiple roles and unpredictable jobs.

ships.name: A2 Hercules Starlifter
ships.description_lore: The A2 gunship has been used to devastating effect in airborne assaults, search and rescue operations, and landing initiatives. With more than double the firepower of the M2, and a custom bomb bay capable of delivering a staggering payload, the A2 caters to anyone hauling massive amounts of cargo through potentially unfriendly skies.

ships.name: A2 Hercules Starlifter Wikelo War Special
Ares Star Fighter Inferno
ships.description_lore: Whether heading up a crew or hunting big ships solo, the Ares Inferno is a force to be reckoned with. This ballistic Gatling-equipped variant tears through gunship armor and turns smaller fighters to dust in seconds.

ships.name: Ares Star Fighter Inferno Wikelo War Special
Ares Star Fighter Ion
ships.description_lore: Spark fear in the corridors of the most formidable gunships and frigates with the Ares Ion. This laser-equipped variant delivers extremely powerful shots to quickly disable the shields of even the biggest enemy vessels.

ships.name: Ares Star Fighter Ion Wikelo Sneak Special
C1 Spirit
